programme.desc: Alla fears she may be pregnant; Garrett has a birthday surprise for Johnna; shocking news from Lizzie's lawyer leaves Scott in shambles; shopping for a wedding tuxedo divides Mary and Dom.

programme.title: Race to the Altar
programme.desc: Ex-gangbanger Lamar meets fiancée Andrea's Mormon kids, and they fear for her safety; Johnna's dad doubts Garrett's proposal; James races to confront Alla and what he finds shocks him.

programme.title: Prison Cell to Wedding Bells
programme.desc: In their race to the altar, Johnna shocks Garrett; Andrea's huge sacrifice brings on a major wedding day meltdown; Alla faces James after rehab; James confronts reality; Mary and Dom take the plunge.

programme.title: The Virgin & The Trick
programme.desc: Clint plans to marry a prisoner he's never met; Caitlin keeps a mother of a secret from Matt; tensions flare when Scott meets his soon-to-be stepdaughter; Virgin Megan is secretly engaged to an inmate who's keeping a big secret of his own.

programme.title: Stopover in a Western Town
programme.desc: A bored young woman (Joan Freeman), stranded in Medicine Bow with her mother, decides to pass the time by seducing the Virginian.

programme.title: Another's Footsteps
programme.desc: The Virginian stumbles into a trap when he agrees to protect a frontierswoman (Sheree North) and her son from marauding Indians during her husband's (John Agar) supposed absence on business.

programme.title: The Fatal Journey
programme.desc: The Virginian poses as an ex-convict to infiltrate an outlaw gang guilty of a woman's murder, but finds his cover threatened by the arrival of another new member (David McLean); guest Robert Lansing.

programme.title: Man of Violence
programme.desc: Trampas acquires unwanted help (Peggy McCay, DeForest Kelley, Michael Pate) when he helps a woman seek her missing husband, an outlaw who has killed Trampas' friend; guest Leonard Nimoy.

programme.title: Fortunes of J. Jimerson Jones
programme.desc: Garth, Betsy and a hotel maid (Ann Doran) try to protect a suddenly wealthy prospector (Pat O'Brien) from a blonde's (Jeanne Cooper) schemes.

programme.title: The Thirty Days of Gavin Heath
programme.desc: After a bite from a rabid dog leaves him with little time to live, a Britisher (Leo Genn) embarks on a rescue mission to relieve his guilt over wartime cowardice.

programme.title: Smile of the Dragon
programme.desc: Trampas' wallet winds up on a dead man after a stagecoach robbery, leaving the ranch hand to be mistaken for one of the outlaws and accused of his own murder; guests Miyoshi Umeki, Richard Carlson.

programme.title: The Intruders
programme.desc: An outlaw (Darrin McGavin) and his men seize Shiloh and lie in wait for a chief (Iron Eyes Cody) and a general coming to negotiate a treaty; guest David Carradine.

programme.title: First to Thine Own Self
programme.desc: A youth (Randy Boone) aids a little girl, then is accused of murdering the child's grandfather (Frank Maxwell), a gold prospector; guest Bruce Dern.

programme.title: The Long Quest
programme.desc: A widow (Patricia Breslin) may lose her adopted son when a woman (Ruta Lee) plans to sue for custody of the boy, heir to a fortune; guest Joseph Campanella.

programme.title: The Secret of Brynmar Hall
programme.desc: A woman invites Betsy and three friends for the weekend, convinced that one is responsible for her daughter's death.

programme.title: Rope of Lies
programme.desc: Steve takes a job as foreman at a ranch owned by a beautiful woman (Diana Hillary), who has plans for the unsuspecting wrangler that involve a confrontation with her violent former lover.

programme.title: A Man Called Kane
programme.desc: Randy's discovery of gold coins hidden in a cave on the Shiloh Ranch attracts visitors -- a government agent seeking Civil War loot and Randy's long-lost brother, who is wanted for murder.

programme.title: Dark Destiny
programme.desc: An outlaw's (Robert Wilke) tomboy daughter (Brenda Scott), placed in the Virginian's care, is torn between her devotion to injured Randy and her desire to help her father escape from jail.

programme.title: A Bride for Lars
programme.desc: Indians, outlaws and temptation make Trampas rue delivering a Swedish mail-order bride (Katherine Crawford) to an injured neighbor (Peter Whitney).

programme.title: Felicity's Spring
programme.desc: A new schoolteacher (Katherine Crawford) wins the heart of Medicine Bow, until her sister (Mariette Hartley) reveals her fatal flaw.

programme.title: All Nice & Legal
programme.desc: A lawyer (Anne Francis) wins the acceptance of Medicine Bow's people by helping the Virginian in a legal matter, but loses favor when she uses her skills to free three outlaws from jail.

programme.title: A Father for Toby
programme.desc: A boy (Kurt Russell) complicates Trampas' romance with a teacher by claiming to be his son; then the father (Rory Calhoun), an ex-convict, arrives.

programme.title: Man of the People
programme.desc: Garth opposes a congressman's (James Dunn) plan to settle immigrants on barren land; guests Arthur Space, Martin West, Brendan Dillon.

programme.title: Return of a Stranger
programme.desc: The tactics of his son (Peter Brown) and an associate (Whit Bissell) threaten a prospector's (Leif Erickson) dream of operating a silver mine.

programme.title: Portrait of a Widow
programme.desc: Garth tells a widow (Vera Miles) that her French portraitist (John Gavin) is a swindler out to get a valuable work of art.

programme.title: The Stallion
programme.desc: Randy recaptures an injured stallion that killed a rider and takes it to a former veterinarian (Robert Culp); guest Donald Barry.

programme.title: Dark Challenge
programme.desc: A rancher (Victor Jory) looking to buy a husband for his crippled daughter (Katharine Ross) offers Trampas a foreman's job and half-interest in the spread; guest Chris Robinson.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: Trampas suspects a writer (Steve Forrest) doing a story on possible senatorial-candidate Garth may be working with a lawyer (Warren Stevens) to threaten the jurist with blackmail.

programme.title: The Girl From Yesterday
programme.desc: Steve decides to romance a woman (Ruta Lee) from his past in order to clear her name; guest Mark Richman.

programme.title: Big Image ... Little Man
programme.desc: A millionaire (Linden Chiles) dumped off a train joins the Virginian's cattle drive, but rebels against orders to earn his keep as a cook's helper and plots revenge against the Virginian; guest Slim Pickens.

programme.title: The Brazos Kid
programme.desc: A magazine writer's imaginings put bounty hunters on the trail of the Virginian; guest Skip Homeier.

programme.title: We've Lost a Train
programme.desc: A series of misadventures plagues Trampas as he travels to Mexico on Shiloh business.

programme.title: Hour of the Tiger
programme.desc: A rancher (Tom Tully) refuses to allow cattle belonging to Garth to escape a landslide by crossing his land; the Virginian falls in love with a Chinese laborer (Cely Carrillo).

programme.title: A Gallows for Sam Horn
programme.desc: An immigrant waitress (Laurel Goodwin) disappears with evidence in a rancher's (John Lupton) shooting of a railroad magnate's (Edward Binns) son; guest George Kennedy.

programme.title: Two Men Named Laredo
programme.desc: Judge Garth delves into psychology to comprehend a gentle, poetry-reading cowboy (Fabian) accused of two brutal murders; guests Ford Rainey, Elizabeth MacRae.

programme.title: A Slight Case of Charity
programme.desc: While in Albuquerque, Trampas pretends to be a hired gunfighter to romance a beautiful woman (Kathryn Hays) who is practicing a puzzling deception of her own; guests Warren Oates, Les Tremayne.

programme.title: Ryker
programme.desc: Ryker wants to shed his reputation as a hired gun but faces a murder charge and a former partner; guests Leslie Nielsen, Anne Helm, Raquel Welch.

programme.title: Farewell to Honesty
programme.desc: After the Virginian accuses a prominent citizen (Richard Carlson) of forgery in the town of Honesty, he faces a murder charge; guests Kathleen Crowley, Harold Gould.

programme.title: You Take the High Road
programme.desc: A young man (Richard Beymer) pulls a gun when the Virginian blocks his herd, which may be carrying tick fever; guest Diana Lynn.

programme.title: The Payment
programme.desc: Ryker firmly believes his stepfather (Lloyd Nolan) has reformed and ignores evidence indicating the older man is gathering people for a new outlaw gang; guest Bruce Dern.

programme.title: Legend for a Lawman
programme.desc: A marshal (Ford Rainey) who believes he is infallible arrests Randy for a murder that occurred during a bank robbery; guests Adam West, William Stevens.

programme.title: Six Graves at Cripple Creek
programme.desc: Searching for the killer of six gold miners, Ryker meets a young woman (Sheilah Wells) whose long-missing father was one of the victims; guest Harry Lauter.

programme.title: Shadows of the Past
programme.desc: Ryker dodges two vengeful brothers (John Milford, James Beck) and tries to figure out why a beautiful woman (Marilyn Erskine) is marrying a shy storekeeper (Jack Warden).

programme.title: Lost Yesterday
programme.desc: The Virginian rescues a woman (Shirley Knight) from a stage wreck, but amnesia prevents her from realizing her life is in danger from two outlaws after hidden loot.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: A ride through the mountains turns dangerous for Betsy when she discovers a legendary herd of horses and a mysterious father and son (Andrew Prine) who fear she will reveal their existence.

programme.title: Timberland
programme.desc: A cowhand (Martin Milner) courts a logging boss's daughter (Joan Freeman), threatening any compromise in a dispute between timbermen and ranchers; guests Arch Johnson, William Smith.

programme.title: Dangerous Road
programme.desc: Trampas investigates a murder suspect (Robert Pine), who claims not to remember the crime, and discovers a friend's accidental death linked to the homicide; guest Simon Oakland.

programme.title: The Old Cowboy
programme.desc: To help an old cowboy (Franchot Tone) keep his grandson's (Billy Mumy) respect, Trampas lets the man work at Shiloh Ranch but soon regrets his decision.

programme.title: Showdown
programme.desc: Sibling marshals (Michael Ansara, Leonard Nimoy) warn the Virginian against completing a cattle deal with the head (Peter Whitney) of a rambunctious Arizona family; guests Tom Skerritt, Dabbs Greer.

programme.title: Ring of Silence
programme.desc: Ryker risks the lives of stagecoach passengers to protect a murder suspect from a vengeful Mexican.

programme.title: Jennifer
programme.desc: Garth's niece (Diane Roter) befriends and is later betrayed by a young cowboy (James MacArthur) who killed a bounty hunter (Hal Needham).

programme.title: Nobody Said Hello
programme.desc: An ex-Confederate officer (James Whitmore), imprisoned for 20 years for mistreating prisoners, arrives in Medicine Bow and fans the hatred of one of his former victims (Peter Whitney).

programme.title: Show Me a Hero
programme.desc: Easterners planning to convert a railroad center meet outlaws hired to ensure it becomes a gambling mecca.

programme.title: Beyond the Border
programme.desc: A lonely saloon girl (Joan Staley) risks her outlaw boyfriend's (Michael Forest) wrath when she tends the Virginian, who has fallen seriously ill during a trip through Mexico.

programme.title: Day of the Scorpion
programme.desc: A stubborn Australian sheepherder (John Anderson) demands a life for a life after his son is accidentally killed during a fight with the Virginian; guests John McLiam, Sean McClory, Harold Gould.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Outcast of Cripple Creek
programme.desc: After his friend passes away, Cheyenne becomes the marshal of Cripple Creek. Disgusted by all the corruption in the small town, he resigns. His successor arrives but may need Cheyenne's help to keep the peace.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Alibi for the Scalped Man
programme.desc: Cheyenne travels to Emmetville for his friend's wedding. When he arrives in town, he finds out that his friend is missing. Suspicious arise around the tight-lipped Emmet family and the bride-to-be who doesn't seemed concerned of his whereabouts.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Assault
programme.desc: Traveling salesman Speed Sullivan, and his son, Swifty, come to North Fork selling lightning rods. Sullivan makes a call at Vashti Croxton's home where he finds her unconscious. When she blames Sullivan for the assault, Lucas must intervene.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Short Rope for a Tall Man
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark travel to a nearby town to sell a bull. While in town, they buy two horses from Mr. Schneider, a man in a hurry. When a posse stops Lucas and Mark on the way home, Lucas learns the horses were stolen. The men want Lucas to hang.

programme.title: Maverick - A Technical Error
programme.desc: Bart Maverick wins a bank in a poker game but discovers the previous owner, who was anxious to get rid of it, unloaded it due to a $20,000 bookkeeping shortage. Now, Bart must deal with the famous Doc Holliday and try to prevent a run on the bank.

programme.title: Maverick - The People's Friend
programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Quick and the Deadly
programme.desc: On his stop to pick up prisoners for Huntsville, Cheyenne learns of Deputy Gary Thomas' conviction of a crime. He believes that the banker's son, Jud Ainley is behind Thomas' arrest and begins unraveling the truth.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Deadeye Kid
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, 16 year-old Donnel O'Mahoney panics and comes to the McCain Ranch. A posse is on the hunt for the young man, believing he commited the crime. Mark befriends and hides O'Mahoney, who is traveling west from New York.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Indian
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart escorts an Indian prisoner back east to stand trial. They arrive in North Fork and Lucas finds out that Buckhart is also an Indian who was educated at Harvard. Angry townspeople try to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: F Troop - The Return of Wrongo Starr
programme.desc: The jinxed cavalryman, Wrongo Starr, comes back to Fort Courage. However, this time he is making the F Troop very nervous with a load of dynamite in his possession. While there, he gets mixed up with a goat after Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

programme.title: F Troop - Survival of the Fittest
programme.desc: An army captain arrives at Fort Courage and tells Captain Permenter that two troops must undergo a survival test in the wilderness. Parmenter decides to go with Agarn. Realizing they must survive on their own, the two face challenges finding food.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Bone War
programme.desc: It's not gold that inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming: it's bones. After stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man is caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Gold Rush Lawman
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of leaving a man to die, mountain man Jim Bridger is determined not to repeat the mistake. When his trapping party runs out of water while crossing a barren desert, Bridger struggles desperately to keep his companions alive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Trade
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley, an old friend, comes to the McCain Ranch. He asks Lucas to turn in him for the $500 reward and use the money to pay for his girlfriend's medical care. However, a bounty hunter has other ideas.

programme.title: The Rifleman - One Went to Denver
programme.desc: Tom Birch, an old childhood friend, comes to visit Lucas unexpectedly. Birch promises he is just passing through on his way to Denver. But Lucas soon finds out about a plot to rob the North Fork Bank and must choose between friendship and justice.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Deadly Wait
programme.desc: Just released from prison, Dan Maury comes to North Fork in search of Marshal Micah Torrance, who helped get him locked up. Torrance carries a shotgun everywhere he goes, but Maury plans to wait him out.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Wrong Man
programme.desc: A crooked marshal comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man. He finds a man fitting the futitive's description. He deliberately kills the wrong man to collect the bounty and then blackmails the real outlaw, who wants to keep his past hidden.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Bass Reeves Tracks Belle Starr
programme.desc: As U.S. Marshal Bass Reeves attempts to arrest Belle Starr and her outlaw husband, Belle asks for 24 hours to find someone to care for her young daughter, Pearl. When the Starr family decides to flee instead, the Marshal must track them down.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Billy the Kid: Birth of an Outlaw
programme.desc: Teenaged fugitive William Bonney is given a second chance when a kindhearted ranch owner offers him a job. But when his new employer is killed in cold blood, Bonney reverts to his criminal ways, seeking vengeance and transforming into Billy the Kid.

programme.title: It Was Our Anniversary, Man!
programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, one man's laundry list of traffic violations haunts him while another struggles to find someone to bail him out before his anniversary ends. Meanwhile, in Modesto, a man faces felony charges for a unique charge, and another sobers up after a big confrontation with his roommate. In Mesa, a mother was two hours short of completing her community service and hopes that she won't have to do jail time again.

programme.title: Love at First Transport
programme.desc: In Virginia Beach, an intoxicated man is causing all kinds of chaos while being detained; in Flagler, a blind love connection forms for two prisoners making their way to jail.

programme.title: Episode 14

programme.title: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a boy scout camp near Farmington, Missouri. A facial reconstruction aided the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: A serial bomber was waging a vendetta against the legal profession. A judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse had been targeted. Employing a range of forensic techniques, investigators used evidence from the bombs to lead them to the perpetrator.

programme.title: Sim'ilar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returned home after working the night shift and found his wife, Paula, unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their two-year-old son, Randy, was asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, was missing.

programme.title: Grave Evidence
programme.desc: Stephen Scher and Martin Dillon went skeet shooting on a beautiful spring day and Martin was shot dead.

programme.title: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan died under suspicious circumstances, his mother was convicted of his murder.

programme.title: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Laura's bedroom was searched and forensic science was used to direct them a to prime suspect.

programme.title: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was sentenced to three life terms in prison, but he steadfastly maintained his innocence.

programme.title: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Broken Bond
programme.desc: A two-year-old boy was rushed to the hospital suffering from brain seizures and breathing difficulties.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. A tiny clue found years later revealed a tragic tale of drugs, romance and revenge.

programme.title: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: A mother claims that an intruder murdered her two sons, but lacking a motive, police use blood-spatter analysis and behavioral profiling to reconstruct a different scenario.

programme.title: The Killing Room
programme.desc: Scott Dunn was missing and when the police sprayed his bedroom with Luminol, a scene of horrific violence emerged. Now investigators faced a daunting task.

programme.title: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: A 1995 fire razes the mansion of a Kansas doctor, killing two of her three children; disturbing accounts from an ex-husband lead investigators to believe the doctor set the blaze herself.

programme.title: Cement the Case
programme.desc: A husband confesses to his wife's murder, only to be found not guilty a year later when a phone tip and forensic evidence point to another.

programme.title: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: When a Pennsylvania man checks into a hospital for leg pain and later dies of thallium poisoning, police investigate his wife and find her in the process of collecting an insurance payment for her previous husband's death.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Police exhume the body of Karla Brown, murdered in her home in 1978, to study bite wounds, which eventually lead to the killer.

programme.title: Accident or Murder?
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Core Evidence
programme.desc: A beverage company pleads guilty to violating federal safety laws when a baby dies from E. coli after drinking apple juice.

programme.title: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: A woman who survived a deadly childhood fire sends police a letter charging that her father killed her mother 30 years ago.

programme.title: With Every Breath
programme.desc: After more than 20 people on a Native American reservation die suddenly from a flu-like disease, Navajo medicine men provide a clue that leads to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: While at a real estate conference in St. Louis, a man finds his wife drowned in the bathtub in their hotel room.

programme.title: Badge of Deceit
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool.

programme.title: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open.

programme.title: A Woman Scorned
programme.desc: When Joann Katrinak is found dead in a corn field with her son, the obvious suspect is her husband. But insects found on the bodies reveal a vital clue which uncovers a twisted story.

programme.title: A Voice from Beyond
programme.desc: When a decomposed body is found stuffed in a barrel, it's easy to presume murder. One of the few clues was an address book found along with the body.

programme.title: Burning Ambition
programme.desc: When a policeman's house goes up in flames, experts suspect arson. The officer whose home was torched arrests a low-level drug dealer, who confesses. But then the suspect vanishes.

programme.title: Memories
programme.desc: Dianna Green was brutally attacked in her own home and her unborn child was killed. After coming out of a coma and regaining her memory, she is able to identify her husband as the perpetrator.

programme.title: Trail of Truth
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence.

programme.title: Material Evidence
programme.desc: When police find the body of an 11-year-old, there are few clues to the killer's identity. But authorities are intrigued by unusual orange fibers embedded in clothing found near the victim.

programme.title: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: Police charge a mentally unstable man with his wife's murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body.

programme.title: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John Boyle in the disappearance of his wife when he buys a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find a body in the basement of his new house.

programme.title: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa as having led an attack against Jews during WWII.

programme.title: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim before his death provides clues to what happened.

programme.title: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt.

programme.title: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When a surgeon is found dead in his home, police assume it was suicide. The investigation reveals otherwise.

programme.title: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: A child was killed in a hit-and-run. The prosecutor has an accident reconstruction expert come to trial.

programme.title: Video Diary
programme.desc: When a convenience store employee is found dead, police find the murder has been caught on a security camera.

programme.title: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Missing in Time

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke

Plus, discover how to electrify barbecue sauce with chipotle (smoked jalapeño) chilies.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Asian Smoke

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Raichlen on Ribs
programme.desc: Ribs epitomize barbecue, combining well-marbled, rich-tasting meat with the primal pleasure of eating with your bare hands. Embark on a rib world tour from St. Louis to Chinatown. Plus, learn how to build an onion bomb that explodes with flavor.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Ham Sessions
programme.desc: Find out how to apply classic ham curing and smoking techniques to anything, from spareribs to turkey legs, to create dishes that are anything but traditional. Plus, learn to make ham in a hurry and an eye-popping bacon dessert.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pork Chops and Pineapple Upside-down Cake
programme.desc: The key to every fabulous entrée, is a fabulous sauce. Chef Stellino guides you through a the simple preparation of an elegant sauce for your everyday meal. A blast from the past ,a sweet upside-down pineapple cake that will rekindle your memory and seduce your palate.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Black Cod with Mango and Ginger Sauce and Sautéed Green Beans
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares his sauce making secrets, to inspire the viewers with this elegant and sophisticated Mango and Ginger sauce that is easy to make and tastes delicious! He also shares some important fact about the uniqueness of the Black cod and his step by step secrets on how to plate this dish with the refined elegance of a professional chef.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Stuffed Meatloaf and Cake with Rum Sauce!
programme.desc: Meatloaf when done right can be a work of art, something worthy of the finest restaurant. It is all about technique and it is never hard to do right. Chef Stellino re-interprets for his viewers a fabulous Sicilian recipe from his youth and in the process he shares with them a series of foolproof techniques for getting done right every time.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Chops with Port & Gorgonzola Sauce and Ricotta Cheesecake
programme.desc: Cooking the perfect pork chop and preparing the ultimate sauce with port and Gorgonzola is a easy as 1-2-3! Making the perfect ricotta cheesecake is even easier. Chef Stellino loves to share his tips and techniques with a passionate delivery and easy to follow instructions.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Ultimate Steak Dinner
programme.desc: Some call this the ultimate dinner, a perfectly cooked NY steak with a Vodka martini sauce! Chef Stellino once again shares all of his secrets in the making a an iconic sauce , the perfect accompaniment to the king of steaks: The New York. Then to sum it all up he shares with us a lusciously sweet, easy to make dessert of pears braised with Marsala!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Luscious Soups!
programme.desc: A soup can be a form of art! Chef Stellino shares his secrets for the perfect soups, smooth , luscious and elegant. Plus he shows the viewers a series of simple techniques to create elegant topping to dress it all up. Simple clear instructions with step by step demonstrations on how to get it done in one try!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - It Is all about Pasta!
programme.desc: Chef Stellino reconnects with his Italian roots as he guides the viewer through some simple and exciting techniques on how to make traditional Italian pasta dishes with the elegance and panache of an Italian born chef, with a plateful of tips, techniques and ideas to help anyone improve their style and performance in the kitchen.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - A Delicious Chicken Dinner
programme.desc: Easy does it!, a delicious way to prepare a simple dish packed with flavor and panache, with easy to follow step by step instructions and plating directions. An old school recipe made simple for today's busy home chefs.

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Special Creations
programme.desc: Nick prepares Parisa's scallops, risotto with sausage, butternut squash & peas &Sicilian-style peppered tuna.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - From The Sea / Dal Mare
programme.desc: Mary Ann sets sail for seafood shores and reels in three easy-to prepare and great to eat recipes: Fish Chowder, Scallops with Spinach and heads to the oven with a casserole dish filled with the makings of Baked Fish with Lemon and Olives that's a breeze to make and a joy to serve.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Party Cakes / Torte per Feste
programme.desc: Simple is best. As proof, Mary Ann's recipe for Tuscany-inspired Prato Almond Cake is as simple to prepare as it is delicious to eat. Then it's on to the dark and mysteriously magical Dried Plum and Balsamic Vinegar Tart as intense to the taste buds as it is to the imagination. Vinegar. Who knew? Answer: Mary Ann.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Ricotta! / Cucinare con la Ricotta!
programme.desc: Mary Ann goes back in time to prepare a childhood favorite: Nonna Galasso's Fried Ricotta with Salad Tomatoes on Crostini. Then it's back to the present with light-as-a-cloud Ricotta Gnocchi. And for a sweet, creamy finish, Ricotta Cheese with Honey and Almonds. Ricotta, you gotta'.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Tuscan Supper / Cena Toscana
programme.desc: Mary Ann travels to Tuscany to cook with Chef Michele Rabazzi, who takes the humble tomato and a loaf of classic Tuscan bread and turns them into the peasant-simple but deeply satisfying Pappa al Pomodoro. Then he fires up the grill for a more upscale dinnertime feast of Beef Tagliata con Patate Duchesse.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Cauliflower, Really? / Cavolfiore, Davvero?
programme.desc: Say what? Cauliflower Crust Pizza? Mary Ann does more than say it, she makes her deeply satisfying, low-cal classic. Then it's time to fire up the deep fryer and mix some batter for crispy, crunchy Fried Cauliflower. And who needs potatoes? You don't, when you can mash up cauliflower and enjoy guilt-free, fabulous Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Little Hankies Two Ways / Piccoli Fazzoletti in Due Modi
programme.desc: Nothing better than generous squares of fresh pasta "Handkerchiefs" tossed with a classic Ligurian Pesto Sauce. And if you have a sweet tooth, Mary Ann has just the thing, when she combines raspberries, blueberries, and sliced strawberries, with sweet ricotta cheese and to create Fazzoletti with Fruit. The perfect dessert for a special occasion.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Exquisite Cannelloni / Cannelloni Squisiti
programme.desc: Mary Ann prepares a luxurious Lamb Ragu to fill equally luxurious, freshly made Cannelloni. And if you're in the mood for an equally exquisite, vegetarian version wrapped inside a lightly browned crepe, then keep watching as she combines broccoli, plum tomatoes, lemon zest, ricotta cheese for Crepes with Vegetables and Cheese.

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Make Mine Mussels / Prepara le mie cozze
programme.desc: Mary Ann travels to cold waters off the Gulf of Maine to reap the harvest of Gary Moretti's Bangs Island Mussels. First up, keep it simple, with a variety of tangy, tasty, Gary's Awesome Aiolis. Then Mary Ann combines her signature potato salad with plump, succulent musses to create a unique and most memorable Mussel Potato Salad.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos
programme.desc: On Mykonos, Diane discovers the quiet life and food of its local farmers, in contrast to the reputation as a dazzling party island. She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Athenian Riviera
programme.desc: Gorgeous cafes, bustling nightlife, yachting and water sports, just 20 minutes south of the Greek capital, Athens. Diane visits a fish market where the catch is right off the boat, sails the coast, and returns to her kitchen to create three delicious, contemporary Greek recipes, inspired by the cosmopolitan bustle and fun-loving spirit of the Athenian coast.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge
programme.desc: Diane and friend and ultramarathoner, Dean Karnazes, meet up for a run. He helps Diane hone her technique, sharing healthy eating tips. Together they make a simple Greek salad with local ingredients and enjoy perfect Mediterranean living. Back in her kitchen, Diane cooks up a very healthy plant-forward Messinian meal, with lots of olive oil, beans and greens.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. They cook a favorite local recipe "kritharoto," mushrooms with orzo. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Culinary Tapestry Of Corfu
programme.desc: Diane explores the rich, cuisine of Corfu, a mixture of Greek, Italian, French and others. A local cook makes a Venetian soffrito, and orange salad. In the market: Corfu's famous kumquats, ouzo-infused figs, local fish. Diane cooks up mixed braised greens with feta, an Italian fish stew called bourtheto and Venetian pastitsio, reworked for the modern cook.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Saving The Earth On Paros
programme.desc: To embrace the cosmopolitan aura of this island, Diane visits Alkis Downward, who created a sustainable agriculture project on one of Greece's most touristed Aegean islands. Discover the food of Paros and its local recipes: rabbit, skate salad and air-dried mackerel. Diane prepares a Greek island meal that will make you want to sail straight to the Aegean.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Busy Mom Seeks... Help!
programme.desc: Ellie takes Beth -- a mom, a full-time labor and delivery nurse, and a grad student -- under her wing. Ellie helps Beth rein in her takeout habit with three easy make-ahead recipes that stock her fridge with a week of tasty meals. Recipes include Blueberry-Chia Overnight Oats, Turkey-stuffed Pizza Pockets, Cajun Shrimp in Foil, and Red Wine Salad Dressing.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Say Yes to Chocolate
programme.desc: The key to having chocolate in your life in a manageable way is to go for quality over quantity. In this episode, we visit the Chocolate Expo and Ellie demonstrates how to incorporate the joys of chocolate into everyday menus, clarifying how to take advantage of its health benefits. Recipes include Fig & Ginger Truffles, Double-Chocolate Waffles a la Mode, Mocha Java Smoothie, and more.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Carbo-diem
programme.desc: Inez's extreme approach to carbs has left her not only feeling tired, but stressed from making separate meals for herself and her family. Ellie helps Inez bring balance to her home, by dispelling misinformation about carbs and sharing healthy recipes she can enjoy with her family. Recipes include Whole Grain Penne with Chicken, Mushrooms & Spinach, Basil Pesto with Spaghetti Squash, and more.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Sweet Tooth Satisfiers
programme.desc: Does sugar have you in its thrall? Ellie helps one family tackle their sugar quandary so they can continue to do the baking they love in a healthier way without sacrificing flavor. Recipes include Crispy French Toast Fingers with Blueberry Maple Sauce, Banana Bread with Chocolate Drizzle, Coconut Date Balls, and Cherry Chocolate Haystacks.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge
programme.desc: It can be a challenge to put dinner together in a working household. And then what happens when you're working opposite shifts? Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore
programme.desc: He's a meat eater. She's a vegetarian. Their kitchen has become a battleground. Can this marriage be saved? It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. Recipes include Warm Spinach Salad with grilled sirloin, Panzanella with White Beans with chicken sausage, Forbidden Rice Bowl, and Grilled veggies & lamb kabobs served with Tahini Sauce.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Teeny Kitchen
programme.desc: Ellie helps out a couple contending with the challenges of cooking in a tiny apartment kitchen. She proves that with just a few pans and gadgets and some smart recipes, anyone can produce fantastic meals in even the most cramped quarters. Recipes include Herbed Salmon & Orzo Casserole with Feta, Beef & Vegetable Stew, Lemon Garlic Turkey Breast with Rosemary Potatoes & Brussels Sprouts, and more.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Pasta
programme.desc: Lidia makes an orecchiette with clams and zucchini. Her spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Roasting and Baking
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, cheese roasted asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, baked eggplant with tomatoes, created with cheese and herbs, topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an almond torte with chocolate chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - More Pasta
programme.desc: Lidia creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a linguine with Swiss chard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Focaccia
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even for stuffing. Lidia begins by making a classic rosemary and lemon focaccia; she then moves on to a filled focaccia with smoky speck and fontina cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a salad of shrimp, fava, and cranberry beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Savory Baking
programme.desc: Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a baked fennel with tomatoes and oozing cheese. She then creates a rollatini of sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon, and white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Risotto
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a creamy risotto alla Milanese with saffron and marrow bone followed by a succulent quail stuffed with Italian sausage and mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy panna cotta with seasonal berries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: Lidia's reinventing Italian classics. Learn to make Lidia's fresh Mozzarella salad not with tomatoes but Celery and walnuts instead. She puts a spin on the classic Pappa al Pomodoro from Maremma by adding clams! Plus, a crowd-pleasing Zucchini Parmigiana, a delicious variation of on tried and true eggplant version.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Tale Of Two Chinatowns
programme.desc: Sara dives into Chinese heritage at Chinatowns on either side of the continent. In Vancouver, recipes for appetizers cooked with Chinese tea and Dim Sum made by an opera singing Chinese local. Then - a lesson in making Chinese dumplings. Back at home, Wok Queen Grace Young describes her efforts to preserve New York's Chinatown as she and Sara make a BBQ Pork and Yangchow fried rice.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Downhome Mississippi
programme.desc: Sara follows a trail in the Mississippi Delta that leads straight to where blues is born. She keeps going to some of the richest farmland on earth where space age tractors bring in the harvest. Here they eat what they grow, and she joins the farmers to make an easy rice casserole and Blackened catfish. Later - the mother of all hometown cookbooks - Charleston Receipts

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - How Sweet It Is
programme.desc: Holidays are when Sara pulls out the stops when it comes to sweets and desserts. Try her Glazed Pears and shortbread pecan praline, or the surprising twist on potstickers filled with dried plum and apricots. On Ask Sara, tips on blind baking a pie crust. Then a favorite food gift in Sara's family - homemade Chocolate Peppermint Bark.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Which Came First
programme.desc: Chicken or eggs? Sara's got some amazing recipes to make them shine, starting with a chicken paillard, slathered in a compound date butter. Baked Chicken thighs are pointed up with the acid of homemade lemon pickles. Then a French chef shows Sara a simple galette of ham and eggs wrapped in pastry - perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas
programme.desc: Sara's in Barcelona to sip gin and tonics in the shadow of the iconic Sagreda Familia, then joins a food writer to make classic Iberico Pork with Romanesco sauce and Gambas Ajillo. At home, Sara whips up Fideo - Barcelona's take on Paella made with noodles instead of rice.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Olive Mallorca: A Wood Fired Feast
programme.desc: Sara's on the Spanish island of Mallorca, where an ancient olive grove tended by sheep is the magical setting for cooking a hunters stew over an open fire. Back home, Sara makes Seafood Gazpacho. On 'Ask Sara', she answers a viewer's questions about Lemons.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Under The Acropolis
programme.desc: Fish is on the menu when Sara joins Greek Chef Maria Loi harborside near Athens to cook lemony, crispy skinned Branzino along with Beet, Beans and Feta Salad and Lemon Potatoes. Then it's off to Athen's Central Market to buy Retsina at a famous tavern for a rooftop mezze party in the shadow of the Acropolis. Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - A Taste Of Tunisia And Turkey
programme.desc: A food tour of Tunisia's Sidi Bou Said with local chef Malek Labidi ends cooking Shakshuka in a beautiful garden overlooking the sea. Later we dive into the Medina in Tunis to watch women hand make couscous. In Istanbul, a shopping trip with local TV chef Refika Burgul, ends in the kitchen making Salt Cured Sea Bass plus the addictive Turkish beef and French fry favorite, Kochertme.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Jumbo Pot Stickers
programme.desc: Bundles of chopped shrimp, shiitake mushrooms and ginger are wrapped in dough and served with a lime.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Smoked Turkey Stuffed Peppers
programme.desc: Sweet red bell peppers are stuffed with smoked ground turkey, crispy jicama, hot jalapeno peppers, kidney beans and rice. Then serve with a creamy cilantro and cheese sauce or roll in Swiss chard leaves and bake in tomato-vegetable juice.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Christmas Holiday Dessert - Cocoa Cookies and Cream Parfait
programme.desc: Chocolate cookies are layered with raspberry puree and whipped "cream" for an elegant yet easy presentation.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Christmas Holiday Main Dish - Roast Pork with Apple Gravy
programme.desc: Well-seasoned roast pork is served with golden potatoes and Brussels sprouts in a rich low-fat orange gravy.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Bangers and Mash
programme.desc: Hearty brown onion sauce is the perfect low-fat topping for smoked chicken sausage and creamy mashed potatoes or baked potatoes with Canadian bacon, onions and apples.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Whole Grain Island on a Parsnip Sea
programme.desc: Five Whole Grains steamed over Rosemary on Creamy Parsnip and Saffron Sauce. Extra cooked grains mixture from freezer, added to a soup base and Kidney Beans make for Going The Extra Meal.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - The Peacemaker
programme.desc: Oysters and Canadian bacon in a cramy horseradish sauce are presented in a hot crusty French bread loaf.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Oxtail and Barley Soup
programme.desc: Beefy roasted oxtails are teamed with shiitake mushrooms and pearl barley for a hearty soup or topped with mashed potatoes in a cottage pie.

programme.title: Graham Kerr's Kitchen - Fried Rice
programme.desc: Seasoned rice and wheat berries stir-fried with Canadian bacon, sun-dried tomatoes, green onions and eggs are served as a main course or rolled in tender collard leaves and served with salsa.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - To Spoon or not to Spoon
programme.desc: Dishes include: Tortellini ala Panna, Pasta Alle Vongole All'Esenziale, Chicken Scallopini / Apple Tart.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Being Italian
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explains the difference between Italians from Italy and Italian Americans. Dishes include: Salsiccie al Sugo (sausages braised in tomato sauce ) / Pasta alla Nanci (with Ricotta cheese) / Pasta with Shrimp (Linguine and Shrimp in white wine) / Sicilian Fish Soup / Pannacotta (chocolate pudding with berries and mint).

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Gardner
programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Food Artist
programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - I Love Cheese
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explains his love for cheese and how it reminds him of memories growing up. Dishes include: Pasta Alla Norma (Pasta with fried eggplant) / Rollatini di Melanzane (Grilled eggplant with ricotta filling) / Ricotta pudding.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Food Memories
programme.desc: Chef Stellino shares how the food he prepares links him to his past, present and future. Dishes include: Salsiccie e Fagioli / Orecchiette Con Broccoli e Salsiccia / Insalata a la Siciliana.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Bacon or Pancetta
programme.desc: Dishes include: Ragu' Di Gamberetti/ Shrimp Amatriciana with Pasta / Insalata Del Sogno / Watermelon Salad.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Family Matters
programme.desc: Chef Stellino recalls the charming quirks of his family in Italy and America. Dishes Include: Pasta All' Arrabbiata (Pasta with a spicy tomato sauce) / Salsicce Brasate con Broccoli e Peperoni (Braised sausages with broccoli and peppers) / Banana Cream Pudding.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Tomato Whisperer
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explores the complexities of the tomato. Dishes include: Tomato Salad (Cherry tomatoes with mozzarella and onions) / Tonno alla Puttanesca (Tuna steaks with a special tomato sauce) / Blueberry Crumble.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Veggie Love
programme.desc: Want to turn a veggie loather into a veggie lover? Ellie reveals some tantalizingly simple ways to reform veggie haters, in the kitchen and beyond. Recipes include Broccoli Pesto Pizzas, Beef and Mushroom Sloppy Joes, and Raw Brussel Slaw.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Beauty Food
programme.desc: You are what you eat and it shows. Ellie helps you feel and look your best with tasty dishes that nourish your skin. Recipes include Creamy curry dip, Green Tea Poached Salmon, Watermelon Salad, and Chai Fruit Compote.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Satisfying & Complete With or Without Meat
programme.desc: If you're cutting back on meat you may wonder what to eat more of. Ellie shows you how easy (and tasty) it is to incorporate other protein-rich elements into your snacks and meals. Recipes include Broccoli and Cheddar Soup, Steak Fajitas, Asian Noodle Bowl with Peanut Dressing, and 3 Ingredient Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Big Flavor, Less Salt
programme.desc: Ellie helps you get the bold taste you crave from your favorite foods while keeping salt in check in your kitchen. Recipes include 3-ingredient Coriander Crusted Turkey Breast, Sweet & Spicy Roasted Root Vegetable, Tri-Color Salad Pizza, and Family Favorite Minestrone Soup.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Raw Vs Cooked
programme.desc: Raw foods are on hot now. But cooked foods have unique benefits too. Let Ellie suss out the facts from the hype for you. Recipes include Gazpacho, 3 Ingredient Tomato Sauce, Zucchini Carpaccio, and Wok Charred Lettuce with Shrimp.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Better Brunch
programme.desc: Ellie hits refresh on the typical brunch menu with some creative, make-ahead crowd-pleasers that break the mold. Recipes include Eggs Florentine in Tomato Cups, Breakfast Strata, Pumpkin Waffles, and 3 Ingredient Brussel Sprout Hash with Egg.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Improbable Grill
programme.desc: The Improbable Grill: In this show we explore three unexpected techniques for grilling. The first stands the vertical rotisserie used in Mexico and the Middle East. The second involves a piece of equipment you don't usually find at a barbecue-a roofer's torch. The third involves a mystery ingredient that virtually no one on the planet has ever grilled.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Cured and Smoked
programme.desc: Cured and Smoked: In humankind's long march to food security, two ancient preserving techniques have stood out over the millennia: curing and smoking. The first involves preserving foods with salt, soy sauce, or sodium nitrite, and the second technique involves blasting foods with flavorful clouds of wood smoke. Today, we're pushing the envelope on traditional curing and smoking.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Maryland Crab Feast
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules Desserts
programme.desc: Raichlen's Rules: Desserts: Take your desserts to a new level of flavor with Grilled Pound Cake with Berry Salsa and Smoked Whipped Cream, Salt Slab-Grilled Pears with Amaretti And Smoked Whipped Cream, Dessert Quesadillas, Smoked Ice Cream with Rum Raisin Sauce.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Best Ribs Ever
programme.desc: Let Texans brag about brisket and Carolinians praise pulled pork shoulder. For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue is ribs. In the American Midwest, ribs mean baby backs or other pork ribs, while in Korea, the bone of choice is the beef short rib. In the eastern Mediterranean, lamb ribs reign supreme. In this show we give you three of the best ribs ever.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Health Food
programme.desc: Barbecue Health Food: A little-known fact-Steven Raichlen's first James Beard Award-winning book wasn't about barbecue, but a book on healthy eating. This show harnesses the flavor- boosting, fat-melting power of live fire to produce grilled fare that not only tastes good but is good for you. From the paellas of Spain to the grilled beef salads of Southeast Asia.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Planet Steak
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire. In this show we embark on some meaty globe hopping, exploring over-the-top steaks from France, Cambodia, and the American Southwest. Hot fire. Sizzling meat. It's a carnivore's dream come true.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Fruit Deserts
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Costa Rica
programme.desc: Billy and Dom journey across Costa Rica from the northern Pacific coast to San José. In Nicoya, a renowned Blue Zone, they uncover dietary secrets linked to long, healthy lives. Venturing into the jungle, they work on a coffee plantation and discover why Costa Rica is the world's leading exporter of pineapples.

programme.title: MIX - Beef & Bourbon
programme.desc: Tamee visits LOCK AND KEY SOCIAL DRINKERY & KITCHEN in Downey CA. Bourbon & beef are the pride of this neighborhood hangout where the specialties of the house are a 4O ounce Tomahawk Steak and the Billionaire Cocktail.

programme.desc: Horse Pizzas, Rope Tacos and Cheese & Egg Toast

programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Dungeness Crab Roll with Carrot Salad, Seared Squab with Rice, and Almond Tuile with Passion Fruit Custard. Restaurants include: The Heathman Hotel Portland, Peristyle in New Orleans, and Le Titi de Paris in Arlington Heights.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Guenter Seeger, Paul Bartolotta, and Gerard Partoens
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Lamb Roulade on Zucchini, Scampi, and Summer Berries with White Chocolate Mousse. Restaurants include: The Dining Room in Atlanta, Spiaggia in Chicago, and The Peabody in Orlando.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Jose Gutierrez, Guillermo Veloso, and John Fleer
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Green Tomato Gazpacho, Fried Rabbit, and Rich Pistachio Brownie with Ganache. Restaurants include: The Peabody Hotel in Memphis, Yuca Restaurant in Miami Beach, and The Inn at Blackberry Farm in Walland.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Tamara Murphy, Roland Liccioni, and Jea Weitlauf
programme.desc: Recipes: Provencal Fish Soup with Rouille, Daurade with French Green Beans, and Cannoli with Zabaglione Sauce.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America: Frank Lee, Gary Danko, and Alan Sayers
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Sauteed Shiitake Mushrooms with Foie Gras, Steamed Moroccan-style Salmon Steak, and Chilled Summer Fruit Soup with Sesame Ice Cream. Restaurants include: Slightly North of Broad in Charleston, The Ritz-Carlton in San Francisco, and Goodfellows in Minneapolis.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Caponata

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Bruschetta
programme.desc: Quick and easy, toasted garlic bread topped with chopped tomatoes, basil and garlic followed by pasta.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Baked Swordfish
programme.desc: Swordfish steaks smothered in onions, cheese & rich tomato sauce served with classic Italian risotto.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Onion Glazed Pot Roast
programme.desc: Family favorite, melt-in-the-mouth pot roast and onions in hearty gravy served with creamy mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Shrimp in the Pot
programme.desc: Tender shrimp cooked in a flavorful sauce of wine, garlic and tomato sauce served with baked tomatoes.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Sausage Stuffing
programme.desc: Flavorful stuffing of spicy sausage, mushrooms, cheese & seasoned bread crumbs fills thick & juicy pork chops.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Roasted Chicken
programme.desc: Flavor-filled chicken roasted with wine, rosemary and sage served with garlicky oven roasted potatoes.

programme.desc: Sweet roasted eggplant with spicy bread crumbs and tangy cheese combine in a melt-in-your-mouth appetizer.

programme.title: Cucina Amore - Seafood Pasta
programme.desc: Shrimp, scallops & pasta are especially flavorful cooked in an aluminum foil pouch, and ice cream cake.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Meal to Impress
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Michael Lomonaco, show us how to impress your friends and be the life of any dinner party with these unique dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Dishes for Every Palate
programme.desc: Martin whips up three delectable dishes that are sure to please any discriminating palate. Today it's shrimp, chicken and trout as only Chef Yan can.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Versatile Dishes
programme.desc: Quick & easy means versatility. Martin demonstrates how these three recipes can be enjoyed for both lunch & dinner, on their own, as a side dish or together as a meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Cantonese Favourites
programme.desc: Martin and his guest, Sara Moulton, explore the exciting world of Cantonese flavours with these variations on some traditional favourites.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Martin takes us on a culinary adventure through the Pacific Rim with these quick and easy recipes for crab, sea scallops and rice. Top it off with a refreshing Guava Bellini and you can almost feel the balmy breeze!

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - Home Cooking
programme.desc: No time? No problem! Martin proves you don't need to spend hours in the kitchen to make a great, home-cooked meal.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - China & Korea
programme.desc: Two culinary powerhouses come together, as Martin and his guest, barbeque master Rick Browne, explore the difference between Korean and Chinese flavours to create these quick and easy dishes.

programme.title: Martin Yan - Quick and Easy - A Simple Meal
programme.desc: Martin shows us how a few simple ingredients can add zing to pork chops, rice and vegetable dishes.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Risi
programme.desc: Three new ideas from a simple pot of rice. We'll set up a risotto bar with lots of creative toppings, make a warm vanilla-flavored Rice Pudding with summer fruit, and mix a beautiful Insalata di Riso with asparagus, fava beans, peas, lemon, ham and herbs. Then we'll see the wine country from the Napa Valley Wine Train.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Primavera
programme.desc: Simple dishes show off the flavor of new peas and asparagus. We'll make a Cheater's Chicken Stock (when there's no homemade stock on hand), a bright green Spring Pea Soup, a quick, tender and lemony Peas and Cipolline dish, and Halibut with Asparagus and Salsa Genovese. We'll see the vineyards of the wine country covered in golden mustard blossoms, and drop in on the Mustard Festival.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Mama's Favorites
programme.desc: Foods that warm the heart and soothe the soul. A ten-minute technique for making olives bright and lively, homemade mozzarella, which we serve en carrozza - in a "carriage" of bread dipped in egg and anchovies - and turkey polpettone filled with a center of melting cheese. We'll learn the stories behind the valley's scenic, historic stone walls.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Surf or Turf
programme.desc: Discover a lemon marinade and other secrets for preparing artichoke hearts. We'll sear a sea bass and make an artichoke salad with red onions, kalamata olives, lemons, and other Mediterranean flavors. We'll cook baby lamb chops and artichokes and serve them with a creamy, tangy egg-lemon sauce. And we'll cross the hill to see the other food and wine-loving valley, Sonoma.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Zuppe, Zuppe, Zuppe
programme.desc: Soup makes a meal and, with a few techniques, becomes a sauce the next day for fish, poultry or meat. Summer Corn Soup, served warm or cold, makes a beautiful yellow sauce for scallops. Tart apples and sweet butternut squash make a soup that becomes a full-bodied sauce for pork chops. We'll visit a ghost winery and meet some third-generation California winemakers.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Buttering Up
programme.desc: Our favorite pantry secret stays in your freezer. Compound butters are flavored with fresh herbs and spices, rolled into logs, and kept cold to retain all their flavor. We'll make a Garlic Thyme Butter, a Basil Chive Butter for steak, bruschetta or corn, and a Bagna Cauda Butter for fresh clams and pasta. And we'll visit some of the architectural gems of the Napa Valley.

programme.title: Michael Chiarello's Napa - Breakfast in Turlock
programme.desc: A real farmer's breakfast with potato hash, eggs, and Damn Hot Peppers. We'll finish with Verbena Coffee and a refreshing honey zabaglione that you can make ahead and chill or serve warm. We'll drop in on Michael's hometown of Turlock, California.

programme.title: Superfoods with Chef Walter Staib - Beans and Lentils

programme.desc: The good-hearted Sprinter Galore is back at his home planet, battling evil villains bent.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn't take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn't give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow's nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown's face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS - ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What's that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie's photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn't stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer

programme.title: Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready - steady - and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK - ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO

But suddenly there's a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.desc: The new owner promises to promote Drew but dies from a heart attack after a prank at Drew's Halloween party.

programme.title: Beulah Gets Her Groove Back
