programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family Splurges
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family In Court
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: Amnesia In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: Thing Is Missing
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: Crisis In The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: Lurch And His Harpsicord
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: Morticia, The Breadwinner
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: My Son, The Chimp
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: Morticia's Favorite Charity
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Progress And The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: Uncle Fester's Toupee
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: Lurch, The Teenage Idol
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: Gomez, The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: Tennis Racket
programme.desc: Sharon receives a peace offering from one of her folk-singing neighbours.

programme.title: A Little Ditty About Jack and Brieann
programme.desc: Jack becomes interested in Courtney Love's houseguest; Ozzy writes a new song.

programme.title: Angler Management
programme.desc: After 17 years of waiting, Ozzy fulfills his dream of taking Jack on a fishing trip.

programme.title: Bye Bye Babies
programme.desc: Jack and Robert fly to England to spend time at the Osbournes' other home.

programme.title: Ozz That Ends Well
programme.desc: Kelly has problems with Bert; Jack deals with violent sleep habits.

programme.title: Catching Up with the Osbournes
programme.desc: Season 2 starts off with a recap of the first season.

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: The family hold a Christmas party in their home, with guests such Eva Mendes and Brendan Fraser.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Ozz
programme.desc: Sharon faces pressure from the powers that be at her talk show.

programme.title: Car Jacked
programme.desc: Jack turns 18 and receives a car as a birthday present.

programme.title: Rebel Without An Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon fret about all of the time they must spend apart as she works on her talk show.

programme.title: Return of the Ring
programme.desc: Ozzy loses a diamond pinkie ring that is worth over $100,000.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: Ozzy has a horrible ATV accident while on a promotional tour with Kelly.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: After three weeks in the hospital, Ozzy is released and continues to convalesce at his home in England.

programme.title: Scent of a Woman
programme.desc: Kelly annoys everyone, particularly Sharon, with her disgusting lack of personal hygiene.

programme.title: Pain in the Neck
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly frustrated about being cooped up around the house.

programme.title: Ozzy Knows Best
programme.desc: Ozzy is upset by Kelly's tendency to wear revealing outfits when she goes out to clubs and parties.

programme.title: Valentine Daze
programme.desc: Kelly continues to spend time with Rob, but doesn't want to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Sleepless in Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Ozzy begins suffering from insomnia. He eventually undergoes testing with a sleep disorder expert to determine the cause. Jack gets a tattoo of a cross on his chest, but Ozzy and Sharon do not like it.

programme.title: Have Ozz Will Travel
programme.desc: The family tries to decide where to go on vacation. Sharon turns down Fiji because none of the hotels meet her standards, while Ozzy nixes a number of other locations for various reasons.

programme.title: Hawaii Five Ozz
programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. His friends invite strippers to the luau and behave in ways that embarrass him. The traveling party winds up leaving without Jack's friends when they fail to show up on time for their flight.

programme.title: Kelly Interupted
programme.desc: Kelly irritates her mother by getting a lip ring. Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.title: Number One Fan
programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.title: The Show Must Go Off
programme.desc: Sharon's talk show tapes its final episodes. Feeling mistreated, Sharon clashes with her bosses to the very end, showing up late on purpose and demanding money upfront.

programme.title: A Farewell to Ozz
programme.desc: Dr. Phil McGraw pays a visit to the house, where he holds a frank discussion with the Osbournes about drug abuse and other issues that have affected the family's relationships with one another.

programme.title: A House Divided
programme.desc: Ozzy appears on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno as a performer.

programme.title: Bark At The Moon
programme.desc: The family's dogs have been excreting far too many times in the house and ruining furniture in the process.

programme.title: Like Father Like Daughter
programme.desc: Ozzy releases his first solo album in six years.

programme.title: Won't You Be My Neighbour
programme.desc: Kelly complains that elder sister Aimee had booked her a gynaecologist appointment.

programme.title: Tour of Duty
programme.desc: Ozzy is working out with a personal trainer in preparation for an upcoming tour.

programme.title: Break A Leg
programme.desc: Ozzy is touring while Sharon returns home, planning to reunite with Ozzy in Houston because she misses him.

programme.title: Get Stuffed
programme.desc: Ozzy mixes alcohol with the pain medication for his foot injury and winds up stoned.

programme.title: No Vagrancy
programme.desc: Jack invites his friend Jason Dill, a professional skateboarder, to stay at the house.

programme.title: A Very Ozzy Christmas
programme.desc: Sharon tells Ozzy and Jack that one of their tour truck drivers had an accident the other day.

programme.title: Dinner with Ozzy
programme.desc: Ozzy talks to Kelly and Melinda about being put in jail for stealing.

programme.title: What Goes Up
programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon visit the White House; Kelly performs at the MTV Movie Awards; Jack pines for Natalie Portman.

programme.title: Must Come Down
programme.desc: Disaster strikes as Sharon is diagnosed with colon cancer and Jack breaks his arm jumping off a Malibu pier.

programme.title: The Ozz Man and the Sea
programme.desc: Kelly takes off for her European singing tour; Jack makes his acting debut on "Dawson's Creek"; Ozzy tries to build a beach fire for Sharon and makes a comical attempt at deep-sea fishing.

programme.title: Beauty and The Bert
programme.desc: Kelly reluctantly brings home her first boyfriend, evoking motherly concern from Sharon, who tries to nip the romance in the bud.

programme.title: Smells Like Teen Spirits
programme.desc: Sharon makes amends with her father after not speaking with him for over twenty years.

programme.title: Meow Means No
programme.desc: Kelly recruits her friend Sarah to play the drums in her band.

programme.title: It's A Hard Knock LIfe
programme.desc: Kelly grows frustrated with all the appearances she must make as a recording artist.

programme.title: Cleanliness is Next to Ozzyness
programme.desc: Ozzy grows increasingly tired of the dogs and their tendency to defecate in the house.

programme.title: Viva Ozz-Vegas
programme.desc: The Osbournes pack their bags for Sin City as Ozzy prepares for a concert and Kelly celebrates her birthday.

programme.title: My Big Fat Jewish Wedding
programme.desc: Sharon and Ozzy decide to renew their wedding vows at a hotel on New Year's Eve.

programme.title: What A Boy Wants
programme.desc: The Osbournes struggle to come up with a gift for Jack's birthday.

programme.title: Fleas A Crowd
programme.desc: The pets suffer from a flea infestation, creating havoc around the house and leaving everyone miserable.

programme.title: Run Ozzy Run
programme.desc: Ozzy continues to work out with his trainer, Pete, who Ozzy jokes may be a robot.

programme.desc: Ozzy and Sharon prepare to leave for a few days on a Hawaiian vacation.

programme.desc: Microorganisms are the rulers and guardians of Earth.

programme.desc: Between five and 10 million different kinds, maybe ten quintillion individuals; insects live the most extraordinary lives, many of them revealed for the first time in this one-hour program.

programme.desc: Insects are very good at making more insects, but it's not easy; insects are tiny creatures living in a big world; partners must find each other to mate, and the next generation must survive in a huge, dangerous world.

programme.title: Part Three: Hive Minds
programme.desc: Social insects - ants, bees, wasps, and termites - are incredibly successful; by some estimates, the weight of ants equals that of humanity, and that of termites equals terrestrial vertebrates.

programme.desc: Contestants must retrieve items from the bottom of a tank filled with fish scales and surf tanker truck as they are bucked off by swerving drivers.

programme.title: Episode 19
programme.desc: This was the 90-minute finale of a two-part Championship edition. The remaining nine players will battle it out in the final stunts and compete for a grand prize of 100,000 dollars. Swim with Gators Inside a giant-sized fish tank, several alligators dropped into the water. The gators had razor-sharp teeth and lethal claws.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Contestants will be locked in a plexiglass box that will be hung from a crane and lowered into the water leaving approx. 1-foot above the water for breathing. The other contestant will be outside of the box where they will build an unlocking device and free their partner. A contestant bobs into a tank of gelatinous fluid for animal tongues. The final team stunt includes a truck car ramp.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on top of a plexiglass platform that covers the surface area of a water tank. On "go", the first team member must enter the water through a vertical tube. Contestants will be standing on a tube that is suspended approx. 100' in the air from a crane. The tube will begin to roll and the contestants must stay balanced on it.

programme.title: Episode 15
programme.desc: Contestants would be required to strip down to their birthday suits, parade along the runway for one minute.

programme.title: Heli Flag Snag/Slugs/Build a Bridge
programme.desc: For the first stunt contestants have to hang from a helicopter skit and drop into the water below as the helicopter flew over a buoy. Once in the water, they would have to retrieve a flag from underneath the buoy, swim with it to a platform, and clip it on a flagpole.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Contestants will be strapped by their waist, ankles, and one wrist and locked to the face of a 20-foot diameter wheel that is set halfway into the water. Contestants drink various types of disgusting liquids at the Fear Factor Bar. Contestants must stand on a swaying platform that is approx. 3' by 3' hanging beneath a helicopter.

programme.title: Episode 22
programme.desc: Contestants will crawl down rope nets hanging from helicopters, collect flags before the floor fall out from under then, and ride motorcycles on a suspended beam.

programme.title: Psycho Fear Factor - Part 3
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a race against time in an exploding room and a snack of camel spiders.

programme.title: 15 Most Outrageous Moments
programme.desc: Three seasons' worth of highlights include body piercing, bull riding, a boat-to-boat crash; host Joe Rogan.

programme.title: Classic Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's jumping between two suspended platforms, a spin at barbershop roulette, and an explosive container launch.

programme.title: Episode 34
programme.desc: Team Episode - Contestants will lock hands to traverse a high platform, pass around hagfish, and tight rope for victory.

programme.title: Episode 15
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants must rescue their spouse from a sinking cage, and dumpster dive as a team.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: This Super Bowl Halftime episode featured six Playboy Playmates. The ladies would have to walk a tight rope stretching between two rooftops 10 stories high. As they crossed the rope, they would be able to use hanging ropes for support. The four ladies to complete this stunt the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Bridge Hang Contestants would have to hang from a trapeze bar jutting from the side of a high bridge. The two men and the two women to hang on the longest before falling would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: This special episode featured four contestants on Spring Break in Cancun competing for 50,000 pesos (around 5,000 in American dollars). Contestants would have to climb into a jacuzzi full of dead squid, remove their bathing suit bottoms, find another bathing suit bottom somewhere in the jacuzzi, and put it on. The three contestants to do this the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Battle of Reality Stars - Part 3
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's escaping suspended cars and a conveyor belt challenge covered in tarantulas and crickets.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Contestants will be standing on the platform that is suspended from a circular truss piece that has gymnastics rings hanging all the way around from the bottom. On "go", the contestants will make their way around the rings as fast as they can. Contestants will lick bugs off of dangling bug-covered ropes and transfer them onto a scale.

programme.title: Ex Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's balancing on a fast-moving boat, facing scorpions upside down, and barreling through barricades in a flatbed truck.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Bull Riding Contestants would each have to ride a 2,000-pound bull. The two men and the two women who stayed on their bulls the longest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Episode 27
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, two tightropes and two hand lines will be strung parallel of each other from windows of the Mandalay Bay Hotel. On each tightrope, small sandbags will be tied. On "go" each teammate must untie and toss their sandbag to their teammate on the opposite rope.

programme.title: Episode 19
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, each team is seated in the front of their own car. The drivers are blindfolded and the passengers must navigate for them. The male contestants head is placed through a hole cut into the bottom of a plexi-sewer pipe, his partner must rescue him by crawling into the pipe and reaching around his head to undo a combination lock.

programme.title: Classic Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being shot out of a cannon, going extreme dumpster diving, and dropping into a landing zone from a helicopter.

programme.title: Episode 33
programme.desc: Contestants will be tumbled under water, be sealed in body bags with bugs, and traverse a course in the downwash of a helicopter.

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: Players willshimmy up poles, bob for gross objects in cheese and perform daring driving stunts.

programme.title: Psycho Fear Factor - Part 2
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a tag-team challenge atop moving cars and a Bates Motel themed escape.

programme.title: Episode 20
programme.desc: Contestants must leap back and forth ebtween boats, make wine out of worms, and straddle two moving trailers.

programme.title: Tall Crappacino
programme.desc: They face three extreme stunts as they are stuck in a car being flown under two helicopter

programme.title: Episode 17
programme.desc: Roof to Roof Jump Contestants would have to jump from a rooftop 10 stories high and clear 16-foot gap in order to land on a lower rooftop. Contestants who successfully jumped to the second rooftop would advance to the next round.

programme.title: All Gross
programme.desc: Contestant bobs in tank of cow blood trying to retrieve as many dive rings in two minutes. They shoot blow darts to determine the number of tomato hornworms that they will eat, and crawl through dark tunnels and retrieves 3 dead skunks in as fast a time as possible.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: On "go", the contestants must climb out of a dingy and up a cargo net releasing flags as they make their way up. Contestants are seated around a traditional Thanksgiving dinner table. Each contestant will have to choose three out of five courses to eat. The decision whether or not to eat a particular course will be made without knowing what disgusting food items will follow.

programme.title: Freaks and Geeks Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a partner challenge hanging from a helicopter, a box filled with alligators and frogs, and launching a quad off a pier.

programme.title: Stage Coach Drag/Cod Stew/Pipe to Pipe
programme.desc: The first stunt is a real drag as contestants hold onto a cargo net being dragged behind a covered wagon pulled by two horses. They would have to pull themselves up the cargo net and get inside the wagon. It's a fishy dinner for the second stunt as they have to reach inside a dead 15-pound cod fish and pull out a numbered chip.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Contestants must climb a 110-foot tower and jump into a net; chewing and swallowing six live worms; crawling through a drainage tunnel.

programme.title: The Bees Are So Angry
programme.desc: Five teams of two compete for $100,000 dollars on a five stunt

programme.title: Episode 24
programme.desc: Contestants must run down a suspended tumbler without falling out, grab ground up bugs with their mouth, and help each other in a terrifying tanker truck task.

programme.title: Episode 22
programme.desc: Couples will hand feed each other in an attempt to eat as much disgusting food as they can in a period of 30 minutes. In this couples stunt, each contestant will be standing on a beam, each with one end of a rope, and they must work their way across the beam. One contestant must lean out away from the beam to gather the flags.

programme.title: Episode 25
programme.desc: On "go" the car with the contestants inside will begin to rotate into the water as they work to unlock their waists and wrists allowing them to escape from the car. Contestants will play a game to determine the quantity and variety of Fear Factor Sushi, made of various gross items.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: The contestants will climb out of a moving tram and grab hold of a cargo net that is attached to the underbelly of the tram. Contestants will drink a blended shake consisting of deboned deep-fried rats. A plexiglass wall with a two-inch lip hangs under the helicopter and the contestants must traverse the perimeter of the wall releasing flags along the way.

programme.title: Las Vegas Show
programme.desc: Contestant must rope-swing between high platforms, play a slot machine which selects eyeballs for them to eat, and slide down the outside of the Luxor Hotel.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Clips highlight some of the scariest and most disgusting stunts of previous episodes.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: A tesla coil shoots down bolts of electricity while the contestants wear a chain mail suit and walk back and forth across the beam transferring metal rings. Contestants are secured into an upright expanded metal coffin, which is then filled with bugs.

programme.title: Blind Date Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's sailing through the air on a suspended cargo boat, a crabby escape, and a race against time while being buried in ice.

programme.title: Episode 17
programme.desc: In this head to head couples stunt, the male contestants will be hung by their ankles to helicopters, they must hold a 3-foot knotted rope lifting their partners no more than 20-feet above the water. Each team will be in their own massive trough filled with fish guts, squid, and fish scales. The couple will pull their hanging fish off of hooks and pull them through the trough.

programme.title: Episode 18
programme.desc: Contestants launch a piece of cow stomach to their partner on a small raft in the middle of a swamp. In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing at a podium on the roof of a 5 story building. On "go" the couples much each complete an eating task. Once they have completed the above task they will be yanked off of the roof of the building and dangled from a crane.

programme.title: Broken Hearts Blood Baths
programme.desc: Four teams of exes must deal with 3 stunts and each other in order to win $50,000

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Jet Ski to Helicopter, Eat Beetles and Rope Crawl

programme.title: Celebrity Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's an upside-down dual dunk and an endurance isolation challenge with bad smells, sounds, and more.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Contestants must find keys in a tank of snakes, play target shooting to see how many beetles they must eat, and bob in a tank for pig hearts.

programme.title: Episode 16
programme.desc: Sky Surfing The first stunt required the twins to work as teams. The siblings would stand on a platform suspended 100-feet above the crashing sea below. As the platform teeter-tottered up and down, the twins had to gather as many flags as possible from the surrounding edges of the platform.

programme.title: Episode 29
programme.desc: Contestants will climb through a 30ft plexiglass tunnel while a fire hose sprays them with a gross fluid. A truss structure will be wrapped on all four sides and bottom by cargo netting and hung beneath a helicopter. On "go" the contestant will begin to work their way around the outside of the cargo netting to release flags along the way.

programme.title: Animal Themed Clip Show
programme.desc: This 30-minute clip show had highlights from animal stunts featured in the first three seasons of Fear Factor. Clips included worms, rats, snakes, bulls, bees, attack dogs, alligators, Madagascar hissing cockroaches, and scorpions.

programme.title: Couples Show
programme.desc: When the game starts, the cabinet will be slowly submerged. When it is completely underwater, the second contestant must dive in and unlock all three locks to release their partner. One person retrieves roaches from a big heart-shaped "candy box" using only his or her mouth and transfers it to their partner's mouth.

programme.title: Episode 15
programme.desc: On "go", a room will begin to be lowered into the water at a constant speed. The contestants must get out of their chair and go to the far end of the room to retrieve a ring of keys. Dressed in a dog bite protection suit, contestants must place 4 presents into corresponding stockings while being attacked by a trained attack dog.

programme.title: Family Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's zip-lining from a lighthouse and a high-stakes balance beam, and a shocking bicycle.

programme.title: Battle of Reality Stars - Part 1
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's navigating a maze in a car with one person on a 30-foot pole and struggle through a swap obstacle course.

programme.title: Old vs. Young Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's tug-of-war on top of buildings, cages filled with roaches, and co-driving a car around fast-moving obstacles.

programme.title: All Female Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants must walk around a 12 inch perimeter while an apparatus which is turning raised in the air, fastest time without falling wins. After that its the Eel tank and Heli Rodeo.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Family Special - Contestants will leap frog between rafts, traverse a tunnel filled with guts and complete an extreme obstacle course

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Players must dive under a submarine and collect glow sticks; munching crickets; dropping from a crane.

programme.title: Episode 18
programme.desc: Contestants will dive to a submerged bus to rescue dummies, retrieve tokens from cow brains and walk over a rickety suspended beam course.

programme.title: Flatbed to Flatbed/Worm Coffin/Tumbler
programme.desc: Contestants must jump between two moving flatbed trucks, lie in a coffin filled with worms, and be tumbled in a giant cylinder over water.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Contestants are handcuffed inside a bag and dropped into water, dipped upside down into a tank of bugs, and time trialled on a transparent high ledge.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Truck Jump, Worm Coffin and Reverse Bungee.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: Helicopter Jump Contestants would be riding in a helicopter as if flew 25 feet above a lake. As the helicopter flew over an island of boxes, they would have to jump out and try to land on the boxes. Contestants who hit any part of the boxes would advance to the next round. Anyone who missed the boxes entirely would be eliminated.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Helicopter Climb Each player would hang from the bottom rung of that ladder and as the helicopter spun above the cold Pacific Ocean, they would have to climb up and into the "bird". The four players with the best times would advance.

programme.title: Episode 26
programme.desc: For this twins stunt, one contestant will be seated in a helicopter and the other will be on a quick-release. On "go" the helicopter will fly towards a drop zone where the seated contestant will release their twin to the water. Working as a team, couples will tear chunks of meat off of a cow jaw using only their mouths and run through a 30ft trench filled with cow parts.

programme.title: Christmas Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants will will have to put out a fire and rescue a dummy from its bed, lay in a pit while 3,000 scorpions are dropped on them. And climb a platform which flips end over end.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: This episode featured six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner would receive $50,000 for their charity, and the others would receive 10,000 dollars for their charities.

programme.title: Go Cart Chicken/Fear Factor Basketball/Water Rotisserie
programme.desc: Contestants must race a go-kart on a track over 100 feet in the air and must stop their front wheels between a yellow line and the end of the track. Round ball in stunt two as the players have to shoot basketballs from four spots. If they miss, they have to drink an 8-ounce glass of blended bugs

programme.title: Dog Attack/Gas Chamber/Car Carrier Drive-Thru
programme.desc: Stunt one is for the dogs as contestants make their way through an urban assault training building and press buttons to raise 6 flags. Along the way, they would have to get past 4 trained attack dogs. Stunt two is a gas as they have to stay inside a room full of CS gas (tear gas). The three contestants to stay in the room the longest would advance to the final.

programme.title: Heist Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's an escape from a helicopter cargo net, a crawl through a horrifying tunnel maze, and a heist from a submerged armoured car.

programme.title: Episode 18
programme.desc: This was part one of a two-part Championship edition. In Part 1 of the Fear Factor Tournament of Champions, the 13 players who had won before on Fear Factor during the second season competed again to compete for the Fear Factor Championship and 100,000 dollars prize. There are five stunts. The men and women will compete separately until the last stunt.

programme.title: Episode 19
programme.desc: Contestants will collect candy canes while sliding along a platform, gift gross food items with no take-backs, and swim under a flaming plexiglass grid.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be dragged by dune buggies, bury their teammates head in worms, and aim for a landing from a helicopter drop

programme.desc: Mama June goes under the knife for her total body transformation; disaster strikes when June drives blind on a blind date; June cheats on her new workout program.

programme.title: Here Comes the Bridezilla

programme.title: Let Boo Boo Eat Cake
programme.desc: Sugar Bear's fiancé, Jennifer, sabotages June's weight loss progress; June goes on a date with the biggest jerk ever; Mama's stress eating sparks surgery dilemma; June and Jennifer go to war over Alana.

programme.title: Mama Frankenstein
programme.desc: Mama June must drop 15 pounds in two weeks; Mama June's junk food stash is exposed, and she has a meltdown; Alana and Pumpkin vow to save her.

programme.title: Mama June's Big Reveal
programme.desc: A surprise ambush gets June back on track to the most dramatic total body transformation of her life; Jennifer drops a wedding bomb; at the final photo shoot reveal, Mama June is unrecognizable.

programme.title: Red Hot Mama
programme.desc: Sugar Bear re-invites June to his wedding; Jennifer goes ballistic; the big day descends into chaos as tornado warnings and June's arrival catch everyone by surprise; June's health takes a sudden turn.

programme.title: Mama's Big Fat Secret
programme.desc: Honey Boo Boo wants Mama June to enter a beauty pageant, but June is focused on her new mystery man; Sugar Bear and Jennifer scheme to get more time with Alana, and they'll do anything to get it.

programme.title: A Pumpkin in the Oven
programme.desc: Mama is shocked by an unplanned pregnancy; Alana convinces June to start training for a beauty pageant despite her lack of talent; Sugar Bear and Jennifer's lawyer encourage legal action against June.

programme.title: Go-Go Juice Gonna Make Mama Win
programme.desc: June and Sugar Bear face off at mediation; Jennifer schemes to get June out of her life for good; Josh is on the receiving end of Mama's wrath; pageant practice with Honey Boo Boo includes gulping down go-go juice.

programme.title: Boo Boo...You're Fired!
programme.desc: Coach Honey Boo Boo is blind-sided when Mama hires a new coach; feeling neglected, Alana runs away; Jennifer plots to get a DNA test; Pumpkin secretly moves Josh into the house without Mama's permission.

programme.title: Project Runaway
programme.desc: Alana runs away to Sugar Bear's house; Mama blows up when Josh's antics go too far; Pumpkin moves out; Jennifer spies on June's boyfriend; June faces a health emergency.

programme.title: Blind-Sided
programme.desc: June is rushed to the hospital to save her eyesight; a pregnant Pumpkin has a breakdown; Jennifer finally receives the DNA results telling her if Alana is Sugar Bear's daughter.

programme.title: All Eyes On Mama
programme.desc: Panic strikes after June's eye surgery fails; Alana brings Sugar Bear to yoga to work on his temper, but he blows up after finding the hidden DNA results; Mama has a breakdown at Pumpkin's ultrasound.

programme.title: Make Womb for Baby
programme.desc: June undergoes another surgery to keep from going blind; Jennifer keeps a huge secret from Sugar Bear; Pumpkin goes into labor and June risks everything to be with her despite her doctor's orders.

programme.title: New Baby in Town
programme.desc: There's a new baby in town but also a sudden death in the family; June gains weight and can't fit into her pageant dress; Sugar Bear is shocked when he finally learns Jennifer's secret.

programme.title: Is He the One?
programme.desc: Alana's disappointment over the pageant cancellation turns to excitement when Josh wants to propose to Pumpkin; Mama catches wedding fever and struggles with her weight gain; Jennifer gets gastric bypass surgery, but Sugar Bear may not stick around.

programme.title: Honey Boo Boo Is Back!
programme.desc: Honey Boo Boo joins Mama June in a new mother-daughter pageant; Alana calls on an old toddler pageant friend; Sugar Bear gets caught flirting with other plus-size women; June strips down for a lingerie shoot and has a sexy surprise for Geno.

programme.title: Tater Totta & Forklift Freida
programme.desc: June and Alana go head-to-head with their hardcore pageant coach who gives them mean nicknames; Josh makes a mess of Pumpkin's wedding plans; in mediation, Sugar Bear is blindsided when Alana demands to have her voice heard.

Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

programme.title: Stagecoach
programme.desc: John Ford's landmark Western revolves around an assorted group of colorful passengers aboard the Overland stagecoach bound for Lordsburg, New Mexico, in the 1880s. An alcoholic philosophizer (Thomas Mitchell), a lady of ill repute (Claire Trevor) and a timid liquor salesman (Donald Meek) are among the motley crew of travelers who must contend with an escaped outlaw, the Ringo Kid (John Wayne), and the ever-present threat of an Apache attack as they make their way across the Wild West.

programme.title: The Stranger Wore a Gun
programme.desc: A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

programme.title: High Noon in Mayberry
programme.desc: Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.

programme.title: The Loaded Goat
programme.desc: Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: Carly Pearce, Tucker Wetmore, Sierra Ferrell, Lukas Nelson

programme.title: Naomi & Wynonna: Love Can Build a Bridge
programme.desc: Ashley Judd recounts her mother Naomi's adolescence in the 1960s Kentucky, where the promising Diane soon becomes a teen mother; as Diane struggles to raise her girls, she soon finds the path to music.

programme.title: Naomi & Wynonna: Love Can Build a Bridge
programme.desc: Naomi and Wynonna Judd, a mother-daughter singing duo, face constant rejection from recording offices, but it isn't long before exciting opportunities start picking up for the duo.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: When a bank heist goes wrong, outlaw Yellowleg (Brian Keith) inadvertently kills a 9-year-old boy -- the son of saloon girl Kit Tildon (Maureen O'Hara). Plagued by guilt over the shooting, Yellowleg vows to help her bury the boy beside his father in the now-derelict town of Siringo, Ariz. With criminal cohorts Billy (Steve Cochran) and Turk (Chill Wills), Yellowleg embarks on a dangerous journey into Apache territory to lay the boy in his final resting place.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.title: Behind All Silver, There's a Cloud Lining

programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to rig a talent contest he is promoting, in order to assure that one of his nieces will win.

When Gauche double-crosses him and leaves him for dead, Link is ordered to team up with Kuroda Jubei (Toshirô Mifune), one of the ambassador's guards, who has a week to recover the sword or commit suicide. Hoping to find out from Gauche where the gang buried their spoils before Kuroda can kill him, Link tries to escape from the samurai.

programme.desc: The luck of Pat Brennan (Randolph Scott) is about to go from bad to worse; after gambling his horse away, he gets a ride from Willard (John Hubbard) and Doretta Mims (Maureen O'Sullivan). Soon, their stagecoach is hijacked by a trio of merciless bandits, led by the especially heartless Frank Usher (Richard Boone). As Usher holds the coach passengers hostage, Brennan falls in love with Doretta and develops a risky plan to free himself and the Mimses, leading to a bloody final standoff.

Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Bad guy Butch Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) leads an ambush on the Texas Rangers, gunning down all but the young John Reid (Klinton Spilsbury), a lawyer who had joined his Ranger brother, Dan (John Bennett Perry), in the pursuit of Cavendish. Reid, who was injured in the attack, slowly recovers with the help of his childhood friend, the Native American Tonto (Michael Horse). Afterward, Reid dons a mask, calls himself the Lone Ranger and begins fighting evil with Tonto.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.
