programme.desc: With the semester coming to an end, some will stay behind and some will be asked to leave.

programme.title: Espejismo de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Una familia campesina vende todas sus posesiones y se muda a la ciudad, donde encuentran grandes dificultades y dolor.

programme.title: Un tipo difícil de matar
programme.desc: El rancho de Tony es blanco de un asalto en Estados Unidos, Ringo el líder de la banda quien también rapta una mujer, sufrirá más de lo que imagina, la persecución será a muerte.

programme.title: Delirio del Poder
programme.desc: Dos hombres crean un plan para terminar con un candidato presidencial y entrenan a una mujer para cumplir su misión.

programme.title: Enemigos a muerte
programme.desc: Dos amigos y una mujer se dedican a hacer trampas y robos como su medio de vida.

programme.title: El mil hijos
programme.desc: El dueño de una cadena de taquerías tiene hijos con distintas mujeres quienes a su vez lo engañan con otros hombres. Él ignora la situación y ellas se aprovechan por la conveniencia de sus negocios. Tras una ida al hospital se descubre la verdad.

programme.title: El Diablo en Persona
programme.desc: Un hombre se enamora de una mujer con serias intenciones matrimoniales y se une a una banda de revolucionarios.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Sucedió en México
programme.desc: Una mujer que planeaba suicidarse cambia de opinión y decide vivir e iniciar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Sexo y crimen
programme.desc: Un médico es extorsionado por el esposo de su amante para que firme una acta de defunción y ella pueda cobrar un seguro.

programme.title: Aventuras de un caballo blanco y un niño
programme.desc: Un niño y un caballo blanco son perseguidos por una banda de bandoleros, quienes quieren apoderarse de su oro escondido.

programme.title: Guantanamera
programme.desc: Una mujer viaja a Cuba y encuentra de nuevo a su viejo novio de la infancia, quien está casado con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: El último túnel
programme.desc: Un ingeniero que participa en la construcción de una monumental línea de ferrocarril se enamora de una hermosa tarahumara.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: Un hombre y una mujer viajan en el tiempo para comprobar la veracidad de una leyenda que afirma que un pueblo entero desapareció completamente.

programme.title: El Hombre sin Miedo
programme.desc: Un abogado americano cumple su amenaza de acabar con la familia de un hacendado cuando este le niega sus tierras.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: El Mofles y los Mecánicos
programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Garra de Tigre
programme.desc: Un maestro de artes marciales cría a tres niños para que sean hombres de bien y sepan defenderse de "Garra de Tigre".

programme.title: El Mofles y los Mecánicos
programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado
programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Brad Whittaker, the new Stock, and Station agent make a good first impression on the women of Drovers Run, but things quickly go downhill from there. Sandra has a surprising solution when Alex and Nick face a heart-wrenching decision

programme.title: Great Expectations
programme.desc: Stevie's first encounter with fallen rodeo champion Ken Logan occurs when she stops off at his garage for petrol. When Ken later collapses at work, he leaves Stevie with a cryptic message, believing she is his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Game of Chance
programme.desc: When Tess's ideal fantasy world collides with reality, she finds herself being forced to decide between Nick and Dave, the two men who love her.

programme.title: When Sparks Fly
programme.desc: Nick and Tess's relationship, or at least what remains of it, is further tested when she discovers that Nick and Alex have started an intensive farming operation and have dammed off the creek.

programme.title: Show of Love
programme.desc: Alex can't believe it when his first love, Tracy Morrison, shows up at Killarney. She soon makes a very tempting offer to Alex; one that appears to involve more than just a business arrangement.

programme.title: Father's Day
programme.desc: On Charlotte's first birthday, Tess learns she has a fight on her hands when Peter returns wanting full custody of Charlotte. In support, Alex enlists the help of his barrister father Bryce to help Tess in her custody battle.

programme.title: Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: An old abandoned well on Drovers Run holds a forgotten secret for Tess, forcing her to re-evaluate her stance in the custody battle with Peter, and leading her to a difficult decision about Charlotte's future. Meanwhile, Harry and Sandra have a surprise for Alex and Nick.

programme.title: Fool For Love
programme.desc: Stevie's ex-husband arrives at Drovers Run with some surprising news: their divorce never went through and he's here to win her back. Meanwhile, Jodi's fundraising for the CFS gets a boost when she meets new recruit Dylan, and Dave and Nick continue to butt heads over Tess.

programme.title: Make or Break
programme.desc: When Tess's truck breaks down on the way to the sale, a stranger named Bree offers to help. Tess sends Jodi and Bree on to the sale with her cattle, but they end up being kidnapped and Tess must enlist the aid of Nick, Stevie, and Alex on her search.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Things We Do For Love
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Little White Lies
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: Rules of Disengagement
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: Once Were Heroes
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: Betwixt and Between
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: The King and I
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.

programme.title: Anniversary
programme.desc: Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death, but she suddenly reappears, strong and composed. She throws herself back into work and declares she wants to hold a party to celebrate Nick's life.

programme.title: Body & Soul
programme.desc: Determined that the Ryan empire continues despite Nick's death, Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future, while Alex goes a.w.o.l after Nick's life celebration.

programme.title: New Beginnings
programme.desc: After a vivid dream, Stevie can no longer deny the love she has developed for Alex, but she struggles to tell him. Meanwhile, Harry pushes for his grandson to live near him, despite objections from Sandra, and Jodi gets the results of her DNA test

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: A week has passed since the fire and Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée and he unknowingly breaks Stevie's heart. Just when Tess is starting to get on top of things, she gets a call that sets her back: Nick's remains have been found.

programme.title: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry. Meanwhile, a jealous Stevie, prompted by Dave, looks into Fiona's past and discovers something shocking. Meanwhile, Tess asks Jodi to move into the main house.

programme.title: Kiss of Death
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: The Real McLeod
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: Where The Heart Is
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: The Big Commitment
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: Biting the Bullet
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: Second Best
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: The Legend of Harry Ryan
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: The Life of Riley
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: The Great Temptation
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: Suspicious Minds
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: Discovering Peru's Earliest Cities
programme.desc: The first cities in the Americas, dating back to 3000 B.C.; investigating the means of subsistence of coastal and inland valley cities; evidence of trade in marine and agricultural products; learning about the sites of Kotosh, El Paraíso and Caral.

programme.title: South America's First People
programme.desc: The earliest evidence of humans in the Americas; Monte Verde and its view into ancient life.

programme.title: Ceramics, Textiles, and Organized States
programme.desc: Observing pivotal changes in northern Peruvian societies; architectural styles; a state identity.

programme.title: Chavín and the Rise of Religious Authority
programme.desc: How the site of Chavin marks the emergence of religion as the focus of public art; Chavin's architecture, with images of its characteristic fanged deity; later religious iconography and artifacts suggesting that Chavin was the center of a cult.

programme.title: Cupisnique to Salinar - Elite Rulers and War
programme.desc: The waning of Chavin's culture; new elements in the Chavin region's archeological record; encountering the Salinar culture; a settlement pattern showing no ceremonial architecture; the first elite housing; evidence of defensive citadels.

programme.title: Paracas - Mummies, Shamans, and Severed Heads
programme.desc: Investigating the Paracas tombs of the first millennium B.C., which contain richly adorned mummies; the significance of mummification; the elaborate iconography of Paracas textiles and the meaning of the supernatural beings they depict; headhunting.

programme.title: The Nazca Lines and Underground Channels
programme.desc: The Nazca and their accomplishments; the Nazca's irrigation system of underground aquifers, aqueducts and wells; polychrome pottery and textiles; the mystery of the Nazca Lines, which may be the result of ritual pilgrimage.

programme.title: Alexander the Great - Conqueror or Tyrant?
programme.desc: Pondering Alexander's identity and story; learning about the ancient sources that contribute to people's understanding of Alexander's life and legacy; examining the ways this figure is perceived by modern scholars.

programme.title: Greece in the Age of Hegemonies
programme.desc: The story of Alexander starts centuries before his birth, in the Greek city-states throughout the Aegean; the conflicts and political crises that shape the Greek world in the generations before Alexander; his father Philip's conquest of the region.

programme.title: Achaemenid Persia
programme.desc: The Persian Empire of the 4th century offers a fierce opponent to Alexander in his conquest; the history of this mighty empire in the two centuries before Alexander's rise; the political and administrative structures that contribute to its success.

programme.title: The World of Early Macedon
programme.desc: Although they ultimately unite Greece, Philip and Alexander are not considered full-fledged Greeks, learning about their barbarian homeland of Macedon and investigating its relationship to the more culturally influential city-states of Greece.

programme.title: Philip II and the Macedonian Way of War
programme.desc: In his victories, Alexander is indebted to his father, Philip II, for his remarkable innovations in warcraft; Philip's achievements, including his reorganization of the Macedonian army; a study of three decisive battles.

programme.title: The Third Sacred War
programme.desc: A turning point in Greek political history; the Third Sacred War, a conflict that pits major powers in Sparta and Thebes in a battle for dominance; the complicated negotiations in this conflict that lead to Philip's control of Delphi and the Aegean.

programme.title: The Macedonian Conquest of Greece
programme.desc: By 346 B.C., Philip of Macedon congratulates himself on some stunning victories; his greatest achievement is yet to come: the ingenious political and military maneuvers, the decisive Battle of Charonea, which gives Philip control of the Greek world.

programme.title: The League of Corinth
programme.desc: Philip's defeat of Greece is matched only by the diplomatically ingenious settlement of his newly conquered territories; the ruler's strategies for running his empire; one of his most impressive administrative projects; the League of Corinth.

programme.title: South America's Lost Cradle of Civilization
programme.desc: The evidence for South America as one of the true wellsprings of human civilization; the diversity of early South American cultures; what the cultures shared; innovations in agriculture, architecture, handicrafts, social organization and religion.

programme.title: How Washington DC Came to Be
programme.desc: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall.

programme.title: The White House and the Presidency
programme.desc: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials.

programme.title: The Capitol Building and the Legislature
programme.desc: How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens.

programme.title: The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
programme.desc: Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed.

programme.title: The Nation's Knowledge: Library of Congress
programme.desc: Visiting the world's largest library; the story of the library's creation in the 18th century; beginning with the Jefferson Building; the facilities of the Adams and Madison buildings; visiting the Folger Shakespeare Library; the Eastern Market.

programme.title: Reflections On and of Pompeii
programme.desc: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm.

programme.title: Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
programme.desc: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area.

programme.title: The Rediscovery of Vesuvian Lands
programme.desc: Archeological finds from the area are unearthed starting around 1594; uncovering the history of Pompeii's excavation in the 1700s, from the kings who plunder its artwork to the modern scholars who seek another kind of treasure.

programme.title: Etruscan Pompeii - 5th Century B.C.
programme.desc: While the last days of Pompeii attract popular attention, the city is a thriving cultural center centuries before its destruction; delving deep into Pompeii's remote Etruscan history; exploring what life is like in this ancient pre-Roman settlement.

programme.title: Samnite Pompeii - 2nd Century B.C.
programme.desc: Centuries after the establishment of Etruscan Pompeii, the city is invaded by the Samnites; witnessing the conquest of the city by these invaders; considering how Pompeii is redefined and expanded by its new inhabitants.

programme.title: Building the Roman Colony - 80 B.C.
programme.desc: Encountering the first Roman inhabitants of Pompeii; learning how Pompeii becomes a Roman colony; taking a tour of the city as viewed through the eyes of two of its chief magistrates.

programme.title: The Earliest Churches
programme.desc: Considering what defines a church; encompassing its religious uses and its functions as a place of assembly; how the first churches come into being; studying some of the best surviving basilica-type churches in Italy; their structural features.

programme.title: The Church of the Holy Sepulchre
programme.desc: Tracing the history of this church in the Holy Land; the medieval reconstruction seen today; the church's unusual structure, which incorporates the "aedicule"; individual chapels reflecting events of the passion of Christ.

programme.title: Hagia Sophia
programme.desc: Learning about the past of this jewel of Constantinople; discovering an extraordinary architectural space; highlighting its dome and interiors; lingering over its mosaics, carved columns and decoration in colored marbles.

programme.title: The Cave Churches of Cappadocia
programme.desc: Pondering the unusual churches of Turkish Cappadocia, elaborately carved into the sides of mountains; the lives of the monks and hermits who live there; studying the churches' frescoes that illustrate biblical scenes and the life of Jesus.

programme.title: Great Churches of Russia
programme.desc: The beauties of the churches of the Russian Orthodox tradition; the religious culture that inspires these structures; their characteristic gilded domes; their decoration of sculpture, frescoes and tile work; visiting outstanding cathedrals.

programme.title: Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
programme.desc: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms.

programme.title: Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
programme.desc: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events.

programme.title: From Camels to Stars in the Middle East
programme.desc: One of the most important yet overlooked periods in human history; the who, what, why, where, when and how of the Golden Age of Islamic Civilization; exploring the Abbasid Empire; how it bridged the ancient world and the Renaissance.

programme.title: Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge
programme.desc: Meeting the Moroccan wayfarer Ibn Battuta; tracing his journey across Northern Africa and the Middle East in the century after the Mongol sack of Baghdad; new insights into the era, including whether it ever truly come to an end.

programme.title: Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
programme.desc: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.

programme.title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
programme.desc: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.

programme.title: A Meeting of Two Worlds
programme.desc: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I.

programme.title: Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
programme.desc: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East.

programme.title: Uncovering Near Eastern Civilization
programme.desc: Egypt, Greece and Rome may be better known to the public; more written evidence survives from Mesopotamia; embarking on a journey through over 3,000 years of history; learning why Mesopotamia's rediscovery is so valuable.

programme.title: Natufian Villagers and Early Settlements
programme.desc: The enormous value of plant and animal domestication; the theories about the transition from a hunter-gatherer lifestyle to agriculture; the challenges that farming presents; a perspective on the cultural sophistication of pre-agrarian peoples.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: The New Testament-An Overview
programme.desc: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom.

programme.title: Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
programme.desc: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament.

programme.title: Biblical Israel - The Story of a People
programme.desc: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.

programme.title: By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile

programme.title: Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Guayabera World
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Yucatán Meats
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they're affordable, abundant, and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor

programme.desc: Frankie's slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, a staple for any Struggle kitchen.

programme.title: Fancy Pants Pasta

programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Best of Salina's Land and Sea
programme.desc: Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
programme.desc: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

programme.title: Making Pizza in Naples
programme.desc: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

programme.title: Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
programme.desc: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Italian Alps Comfort Food
programme.desc: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

programme.title: Pulled Pork Party Hero
programme.desc: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

programme.title: Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
programme.desc: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

programme.title: Smoked Brisket Hero
programme.desc: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

programme.title: Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
programme.desc: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

programme.title: Steakhouse Hero
programme.desc: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

programme.title: Mexican Carne Asada Hero
programme.desc: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

programme.title: Greek Spit Roast Lamb
programme.desc: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

programme.title: Live Fire Whole Trout
programme.desc: Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

programme.title: Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
programme.desc: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

programme.title: Barbecued Pork Steak
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

programme.title: Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast
programme.desc: Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

programme.title: Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

programme.title: The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
programme.desc: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

programme.title: Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
programme.desc: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

programme.title: Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
programme.desc: Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

programme.title: Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
programme.desc: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

programme.title: Hunting for Quail in Charleston
programme.desc: Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

programme.title: South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
programme.desc: When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

programme.title: The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
programme.desc: Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

programme.title: Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

programme.title: Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
programme.desc: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

programme.title: South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
programme.desc: Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London.

programme.title: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

programme.title: Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens
programme.desc: Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

programme.title: West Tennessee Whole Hog
programme.desc: Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

programme.title: The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs
programme.desc: Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

programme.desc: A woman embarks on a journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before the world ends.

programme.title: Best Men
programme.desc: A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: Martin Short stars as a ten-year-old who plans revenge on his uncle (Charles Grodin).

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: Weird Al Yankovic plays a daydreamer who becomes the manager of a TV station that's losing ratings and money.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our righteous heroes Bill and Ted discover their destiny in a time-travelling phone booth! Excellent!

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: The titular time travelers become history when they wind up face to face with the Grim Reaper!

programme.title: Teen Wolf (1985)
programme.desc: In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: A powerful portrait of disaffected teens based on the horrifying real-life murder of a young California girl.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Passion and power struggles unfold when a young woman will do anything to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl!

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Robin Williams headlines this joy ride of comic lunacy about a car salesman who must face a jealous husband.

programme.title: Mac And Me
programme.desc: Greetings, Earthlings. A pint-sized extraterrestrial has just landed on Earth by accident...and he's feeling a little, well, alienated because he got separated from his family. But MAC will transform the lives of everyone he meets...forever!

programme.title: All Dogs Go To Heaven (1989)
programme.desc: A host of stars voice this delightful animated tale of a dog sent back to Earth from Heaven.

programme.title: All Dogs Go To Heaven 2
programme.desc: Those lovable mutts Charlie and Itchy return for an all new animated, musical adventure!

programme.title: The Secret Of Nimh
programme.desc: To save her family from a farmer's plow, a mild-mannered mouse has a plan to move her house!

programme.title: Igor
programme.desc: To prove himself, Igor, a mad scientist's assistant, creates a sweet, show-tune-singing monster.

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three singing caballeros blaze a side-splitting trail across the western frontier!

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: A wayward teen finds comfort and friendship with the military dog of his deceased older brother.
