programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (9/13/74)
programme.desc: When Johnny Carson encounters the animal kingdom, it's always a great time! Animal expert and advocate Joan Embery brings some fascinating creatures into the studio, educating and entertaining both Johnny and you.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (2/23/77)
programme.desc: Snakes...why did it have to be snakes? Because animal expert Joan Embery brought them, along with a goose and a marmoset!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Leonard Waxdeck's Birdcallers (6/2/78)
programme.desc: Leonard J. Waxdeck joins Johnny to talk about the bird calling contest he sponsors, and treats the audience with a demonstration from some of the winners.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Jim Fowler (1/31/80)
programme.desc: Jim Fowler, zoologist and host of the famed "Wild Kingdom" program, brings a vulture and two oppossums into the studio, along with some tigers that had previously appeared on the show as cubs.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (5/28/80)
programme.desc: What's Joan Embery brought for Johnny this time? A Gila Monster and an anteater, for starters.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Leonard Waxdeck's Birdcallers (6/7/83)
programme.desc: Leonard Waxdeck returns to the panel, with more incredible bird callers in tow.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Zippy The Chimp (5/9/86)
programme.desc: The famed Zippy The Chimp, along with his close friend Jack Rynsky, takes his turn on the panel with Johnny.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - Tom Snyder (6/7/77)
programme.desc: One of late-night TV's great hosts, Tom Snyder confesses it's hard being Johnny's guest. Tom also describes his life in California and bites back at his many critics.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - David Letterman (11/24/78)
programme.desc: Johnny's heir apparent David Letterman recalls his first appearance on The Tonight Show, his Indiana childhood and his penchant for power tools.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - Dick Cavett (4/7/81)
programme.desc: Fellow talk show host Dick Cavett covers a lot of ground: girl pigeons, the guy who invented the bra, legendary fighter Jack Johnson and the Germans' sense of humor.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - Dick Cavett (2/5/82)
programme.desc: Dick Cavett in jogging shorts? Johnny describes Cavetti's jitter-calming pre-show run. Cavett tells the story of a guest who died on his show and then...does a magic trick.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - Dr. Ruth Westheimer (6/11/82)
programme.desc: Sex expert Dr. Ruth Westheimer talks about her new book, "Dr. Ruth's Guide for the Sexually Perplexed", and shares some of the funniest questions she gets asked.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Talk Show Greats - Dick Cavett (9/20/83)

Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter - defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Stage 1 - FINLAND - ICEMAN
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Stage 2 - MARTINIQUE - 2024
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Stage 3 - HUNGARY - 2024
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Stage 4 - SERBIA - 2024
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Stage 5 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Stage 6 - HOLLAND - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Stage 8 - ESTONIA - 2024
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Stage 9 - PORTUGAL - 2024
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Stage 10 - POLAND - 2024
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Stage 11 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Stage 12 - DUBAI - 2024 - Part 2
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Stage 13 - CYPRUS - 2024
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Stage 14 - SOUTH AFRICA - 2024
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Stage 01 - ICEMAN - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Stage 02 - Latvia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Stage 03 - Serbia
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Stage 04 - Italy
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Stage 05 - Holland Part 1
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 06 - Holland Part 2
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Stage 07 - Worlds Strongest Viking - Finland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World's Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Stage 08 - Worlds Strongest Latino - Portugal
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World's Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Stage 09 - Worlds Strongest Truckpull - England
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Stage 10 - Poland
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Stage 11 - Hungary
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Stage 12 - USA Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events - including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal's Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Stage 13 - SCL USA Part 2
programme.desc: It's the final day of the Strongman Champions League's first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120-200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Stage 14 - Dubai Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Stage 15 - Dubai Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Stage 16 - South Africa Part 1
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Stage 17 - South Africa Part 2
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World's Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: I Could Eat a Horse
programme.desc: Danny and Mike head to Wyoming to buy a horse; Delinda looks for a new chef for the casino restaurant; Piper hides from her ex.

programme.title: 3 Babes, 100 Guns and a Fat Chick
programme.desc: Bounty hunters and FBI agents descend on the Montecito when they track a fugitive from justice to the area; Sam tries to help one of her whales pick up the pieces of his broken life; Piper throws a post-New Year's party, and cash starts rolling in.

programme.title: Secrets, Lies and Lamaze
programme.desc: Piper gets in trouble with the gaming commission; Sam gets caught speeding and must attend traffic school; Danny and Delinda meet a "perfect" pair at a parenting class.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Breakfast
programme.desc: Sam gets help from The Cleaner when she needs to get rid of evidence after her whales visit a strip club; Mike and Piper (Camille Guaty) sample the wares of a hot new bartender they are trying to lure to the Montecito.

programme.title: 2 on 2
programme.desc: Piper's evaluation for the Concierge of the Year award tests her skills; Danny and Mike decide to play in a two-on-two basketball competition where the stakes become more than they anticipated.

programme.title: Win, Place, Bingo
programme.desc: Cooper, Danny and Mike are suspicious of a man (Terry Bradshaw) who has a nearly perfect winning streak; Sam's whale brings his grandmother (Kathryn Joosten) to the casino to play bingo.

programme.title: Three Weddings and a Funeral
programme.desc: Thieves try to steal a rare stamp that is up for auction at the Montecito, taking Danny, Piper, Mitch and the surveillance room hostage; Mike's mom discovers that he is married.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Big Ed Deline leads a surveillance team charged with maintaining security at one of the largest casinos in Sin City; protégé Danny McCoy must foil a team of high-tech cheats.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas, Stays in Vegas
programme.desc: The body of Danny's childhood friend is found in the desert; Ed conceals the identity of an ultraconservative senator; Mary contends with an actor who takes his role as King Arthur too seriously.

programme.title: Donny, We Hardly Knew Ye
programme.desc: Danny and Ed become suspicious when a high roller cashes in chips but never plays a hand; Ed's cousin meets the woman of his dreams at the roulette wheel and decides to get married immediately.

programme.title: Jokers and Fools
programme.desc: Cheaters plan to score $10 million with the help of the best pit boss in Vegas -- Nessa; a psychic warns Mary of an audience member's death; Sam plays matchmaker for a lonely lady.

programme.title: Groundhog Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Ed hunt for a sexual predator targeting hotel guests; Danny and Mike suspect three MIT students of planning an electronic heist when they arrive with the latest high-tech equipment.

programme.title: Semper Spy
programme.desc: When Ed leaves Danny in charge of the hotel, a computer glitch causes hundreds of guests to be locked out of their rooms.

programme.title: Pros and Cons
programme.desc: A con artist (Alana De La Garza) scams the daughter of a surveillance specialist into exchanging counterfeit chips for cash; Mary helps a couple down on their luck with tickets to see Wayne Newton.

programme.title: Luck Be a Lady
programme.desc: A stalker disrupts a pop diva's (Sheryl Lee Ralph) performance at the hotel; Ed reunites with a former partner (Mimi Rogers); Sam tries to evict a guest lodged in a prime suite who refuses to gamble.

programme.title: Year of the Tiger
programme.desc: Sam brings one of the premier high rollers (Michael Paul Chan) to the Montecito, promising to arrange a rare reunion with his two high-profile daughters.

programme.title: Decks and Violence
programme.desc: Danny and Ed search the hotel when a member of a husband-and-wife magic troupe vanishes; Mike runs into an old friend from college.

programme.title: Blood and Sand
programme.desc: Ed and Danny referee clashes between rival camps during the premier boxing match of the year; Danny threatens to cancel the fight after the theft of a manager's prosthetic limb; Ed questions the fluctuating odds on an undercard fight.

programme.title: Hellraisers and Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Ed's former CIA buddy (Alec Baldwin) installs a security system which immediately detects a breach made by a computer hacker staying at the hotel.

programme.title: The Night the Lights Went Out in Vegas
programme.desc: A hotel guest is shot dead on the casino floor during a blackout; trapped Danny and Mary rehash old feelings; Mike and Ed are locked inside the surveillance room.

programme.title: Things That Go Jump in the Night
programme.desc: Danny and Ed introduce a suicidal guest (Jon Lovitz) to the thrill of gambling; Sam gets cozy with a client, then his fiancée (Paris Hilton) comes to town.

programme.title: Die Fast, Die Furious
programme.desc: An action star (Jean-Claude Van Damme) dies while executing a stunt for his latest movie; a rival casino host squares off against Sam for the patronage of a high roller.

programme.title: New Orleans
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Sam follow a high roller to New Orleans to collect $5 million; an unruly clan of farmers gathers for a family reunion; Mike coordinates the world's largest wet T-shirt contest.

programme.title: You Can't Take It With You
programme.desc: A resident (Sean Astin) wins the jackpot at a slot machine, then fakes his own death; Ed's mother (June Lockhart) regales the staff with stories of her son's childhood; a couple uses coupons to avoid spending any money in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Nevada State
programme.desc: An escaped murderer seeks revenge against Sam for testifying against him; the hotel hosts a statewide cheerleading competition; Nessa discusses the merits of Manchester United with a trio of rowdy British soccer fans.

programme.title: Sons and Lovers
programme.desc: Thieves snatch a guest's wallet before he can spend his winnings; the security team assesses a suspicious machine with an unusually high payout pattern; Ed discovers Jillian (Cheryl Ladd) has been hanging out with singer Mark McGrath.

programme.title: The Strange Life of Bob
programme.desc: Nessa tries to uncover the truth about a mystery man (Christian Kane) known only as "Bob the rover"; Danny hunts for a peeping cameraman; Sam enters an eating contest.

programme.title: Family Jewels
programme.desc: Danny asks Mike for his technical expertise when someone steals $5 million in diamonds from one of the guests.

programme.title: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Nessa attempts to calm a blackjack player with a bomb strapped to his chest, while Danny discovers there is another bomb planted by an accomplice.

programme.title: Always Faithful
programme.desc: Danny and Mike search for the source of the phony $100 bills suddenly surfacing at the casino, despite Danny's urgent letter requiring him to report back to active duty.

programme.title: Have You Ever Seen the Rain?
programme.desc: Danny surprises everyone by returning home, but his memories of the war make it hard for him to adjust to life; Ed, Mike and Danny must track down three suspicious characters who are making mischief in the casino.

programme.title: The Count of Montecito
programme.desc: Danny and Sam try to figure out the tactics of a ring of card counters; Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) professes his love for Nessa, much to her dismay; Ed and Danny deal with an archaeologist's find near the hotel pool.

programme.title: Blood Is Thicker
programme.desc: Ed is framed for murder when enemies from his past resurface, and Danny and Mike take matters into their own hands; Sam, Mary, Nessa and Delinda select what they believe are the perfect tenants for their new investment property.

programme.title: Catch of the Day
programme.desc: Danny and Mike investigate when a truckload of lobsters is stolen en route to the hotel, while Sam travels across the country to get replacement lobsters.

programme.title: Good Run of Bad Luck
programme.desc: Danny agrees to help the wife of an ex-Marine by watching her baby while she attends an interview, but he becomes concerned when she doesn't return; Sam hosts a man who intentionally throws his money away to confound his soon-to-be ex-wife.

programme.title: Games People Play
programme.desc: Nessa questions everything Ed has told her about her father when a mysterious woman tells her that he is still alive and wishes to contact her.

programme.title: Montecito Lancers
programme.desc: Danny and Mike prepare their youth football team for the Casino League championship game and search for a missing casino employee and aspiring inventor, who is the father of one of the team members.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Mike work to help Dr. Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and Detective Woody Hoyt (Jerry O'Connell) as they try to solve the murder of a high-stakes gambler who appears to have had many enemies.

programme.title: Degas Away With It
programme.desc: Ed uses past connections and old-school tactics to track down the thief who stole a priceless work of art from the Montecito, leading to a tense reunion with his former partner (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ed tries to get the Montecito reopened while working for a new boss and trying to lure back his former staff.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: Lyle & Substance

programme.title: Like a Virgin

programme.title: Chaos Theory

programme.title: Fidelity, Security, Delivery

programme.title: Father of the Bride Redux

programme.title: Died in Plain Sight

programme.title: The Story of Owe

programme.title: White Christmas

programme.title: Wines and Misdemeanors

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Two brothers are worried about their cow, who is foaming at the mouth. Peter also has a daunting visit to the Greens' farm. Dusty the cat has an injury, but won't be easy to help. An animal lover finds a pigeon with a deformed leg.

programme.title: Winter Babies
programme.desc: We look at playful youngsters who extract the most fun out of winter. Brown bear babies enjoy this time of the year along with baby snow monkeys enjoying time in hot springs. Tasmanian Devil babies seek out a cosy den.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter tries to save a cow who has suffered a huge prolapse after giving birth. With the newborn calf depending on her mum, the pressure is on.

programme.title: Even More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We return to the zoos to meet up with more babies, wild cat kittens, chimpanzees, and panda cubs are featured.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Matt and David meet equine rock star Jon Bon Pony. Peter treats a farmer's trusty Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail. Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg. Robin aids a pregnant ewe.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter desperately tries to deliver thirteen puppies who are drowning in their own fluid. Saving a sick school guinea pig is a big test for Julian. And on the Greens' farm, Jean throws a surprise party for Steve's 90th.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Is Lane the dachshund pup the perfect match for Arnav and his parents? Can lovebirds James and Melissa win over aloof Aspen, the Japanese Spitz? Finally, will scruffy sweet Caroline find good times with Jay and Christine?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In Staffordshire, Inspector Charlotte Melvin comes to the aid of two Border Collies living in hazardous conditions. And that's not the only thing troubling her; because their owner is struggling to cope...

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter meets his most tricky client yet, Possum the uber-angry pussycat. Nykee the alpaca may have a life-threatening and excruciatingly painful condition. Can Julian save both mum and baby? Peter meets much-loved ram, Diamond, who has eye problems. Working sheep dog, Flynn, has a suspected broken leg. Will Julian be able to get him back to running with his flock?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Peter Wright needs to act fast to save a cow with heart failure, only to find something unexpected in its stomach. A beagle goes through a difficult birth and a hamster arrives for a simple procedure that ends up proving tricky. Ethel the vulture gets territorial when Peter arrives with a microchip.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A farmer fears his sheep has been shot. But has it suffered an attack by a dog or a fox? Peter's worried about a tawny owl whose eye he removed 18 months ago. Flynn now has a serious problem with his remaining eye, which means his life is in danger.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: It's Sunday morning, but it's no day of rest for Julian as he heads to the Taylors' farm. One of their sheep has prolapsed a few days after he delivered her lamb, and Julian has his work cut out to receive another reward of freshly laid eggs.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter faces a difficult calving at Ed McDonald's farm. The cow is an experienced mum and Ed is an experienced farmer, so Peter senses it's a serious problem.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Will Australian Shepherd Alfie and the Holmes Family find their new mate? Will 'stage-5-clinger' Missy be too much for a first time owner? Will shy shaggy Doug be the right fit for the Billich family?

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Julian rushes over to see worried and confused farmer Joe Holmes. He found one of his cows with afterbirth hanging out, so he thought she'd already calved. But there's no sign of a new arrival, so he suspects she's struggling to give birth.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Can a father and son duo look past Cara the beagle's anxiety and give her a shot? The Ford family look for a new canine companion for their nervous therapy dog Lucy. Plus, Parmigiana's second chance.

programme.title: More Urban Babies
programme.desc: We are back in the towns and cities to visit babies who brighten our lives, some more unusual than you might imagine... Kangaroo joey, raccoon kits and fruit-bat babies.

programme.title: Summer Babies
programme.desc: This time we see the baby animals in the summer. Among the animals featured are tigers, orangutans, and green sea turtle hatchlings.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the veterinary documentary series. New scenes include Dave the baby emu, Dougie the pugnacious parrot, Bobby the police sniffer dog and highlights of a hectic lambing season.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian decides to conduct a fertility test on an unproductive ram. Peter tends to a spaniel that needs major surgery after being hit by a car. Julian has to travel to Thirsk to tend to the wounded following a battle between two terrapins.

programme.title: African Savanna Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: The trainee RSPCA Inspectors' extraordinary year of training is drawing to a close. The students are out on the beat, working real-life cases by themselves and desperate to show they're ready to become full-time Inspectors. They are on probation and only those who consistently meet the standards expected of them by bosses will be offered a job. It's a race against time.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Julian races to an emergency at a local farm where a cow is unable to stand up. She's suffering from a condition called milk fever, caused by calcium deficiency. It's classic, Herriot style vet work and Julian has to be extremely careful with his treatment.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A lamb is rushed to the Huddersfield hospital with a ruptured eye. He needs surgery, but Matt's worried there might be a problem with the lamb's other eye. Peter operates on a Staffordshire Bull Terrier, Julian castrates a miniature pony.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: It's a distressing day for Inspector Anthony Joynes after he's called to investigate the case of Harvey, a Border Collie so thin it had to be put to sleep on humane grounds. But there's more upset in store when Anthony turns up at Harvey's registered address and finds another dog just days away from death.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Inspector Herchy Boal rescues three dogs from an abusive owner but things take a distressing turn when it's revealed they're suspected to be Pit Bulls and so may have to be put to sleep.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A 4-week-old lamb is rushed in to see Peter. After being unwell recently, it suffered a prolapse, and Peter thinks the solution might just lie in the practice's kitchen. Julian attends to a dog that's been kicked in the face by a horse.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. Julian introduces us to their rabbit Luna, but she has to learn to share as they take in a new stray Boris. In order to welcome him into the family Boris will need to be castrated.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian visits house pig Pigley Scott, who has had a horse tread on his trotter. Father and son farmers are worried about Roger, their prize bull, who has a large lump on his neck that may be a tumour.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Julian and head nurse Sarah tend to an injured swan at a fishing lake. Meanwhile, Bobby (a canine member of the North Yorkshire police force) is brought in to the surgery to have an operation.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: For the first time, presenter Alan Davies will be based at one of the country's busiest animal hospitals. He will experience first-hand just what life is like treating sick and injured canines in the cold December months, as he joins the team at RSPCA Putney.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode Peter gets a call to help a Mother ewe deliver her baby lambs, but there are complications when Peter finds out the two are tangled in the womb. We meet one of the youngest chicken farmers, Jack, who has a few bad eggs in the flock in desperate need of help.

programme.title: At Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas but life never stops at the practice! At John Swales' farm one of his prize-winning Limousins is struggling to give birth. The calf won't budge and the lives of both mum and baby are at risk. Can Peter save them both or is he too late?

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Grey nomads Warren and Jan are on the hunt for a four-legged companion. Mum Karen and daughter Edie meet Parmigiana, a gentle and energetic border collie.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: A rare-breed pony is in danger when she suffers a prolapsed uterus after giving birth. Julian has a plan to fix a Great Dane's debilitating knee injury. Peter treats a pig that lives in the back garden of the owner of the local chip shop.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Peter faces an emergency midnight lambing, Julian has to operate to remove his dog's tooth, Poppy the cat requires complex surgery on her badly broken leg. Peter, Julian and the Huddersfield vets meet up for a ramble on the moors.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, Julian treats a much-loved moggie with a badly swollen eye where surgery might be the only option. Head Nurse Sarah is extremely worried about her own dog, Copper, who is off his food, losing weight and going downhill fast. When Julian gets an emergency call out to a ewe struggling to deliver twin lambs, it is a race against time to save the lives of both mother and her babies.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian dashes to the scene of a freak accident - something he's never seen before. A young mum's life hangs in the balance. Can Julian save mum and will she ever be reunited with her little lamb who's been left alone out in the field?

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter rushes to help a cow, who after delivery, has accidentally pushed out her uterus. Julian goes head to head with Arnie the ram who is very intimidating for those who look his way, but unfortunately he is struggling with his own sight.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian is called out to a poorly three day old calf who's collapsed and looking very sorry for itself. Julian suspects a bacterial infection and warns farmer Stuart Robinson that the calf could be contagious. But, if Farmer Stuart's family don't practice good hygiene our vet warns 'they could all be shitting like mad.' Unlucky Terrier Holly has been brought into the surgery after falling off a bed.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter Wright receives an emergency call from his favourite farming clients, Steve and Jean Green, whose poorly calf Treacle has collapsed and remains in a weak condition. There is also food for thought for a pair of alpacas, who have been binge eating after breaking into their food store.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt rushes to a local cattle farm to help Tilly the cow give birth. Mike and Rebecca have an amorous pony, who needs an appointment with Peter and Julian operates on a young girl's poorly guinea pig, but he is shocked by what he finds.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: It's early Spring, and the Trainee RSPCA Inspectors still need to pass nine months of rigorous teaching, physical tests and on-the-job assessment if they're to be offered the dream job. The group are out shadowing qualified Inspectors working real-life investigations. The group also get their first chance to experience some practical training as they get hands-on with a variety of wildlife.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton, is called out to a local petting farm to help a bad-tempered goat with a suspected broken leg - but the goat is not keen on getting treatment! When Peter takes an emergency call from an anxious trainer, it could be the end of the line for a horse that has cut open its foot while grazing in a field.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Julian needs as many extra pairs of hands as he can muster as he has to perform a caesarean section on a pregnant Great Dane. Later, young vet Matt marries his fiancee Katherine in front of all of his veterinary friends.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The student RSPCA Inspectors are now entering the last and toughest stage of their year-long training. They're investigating cases by themselves for the first time ever. If they make it through these final few months, they'll be offered a full-time position, but for now they're on probation with no guarantee of success.

programme.title: Mountain Babies
programme.desc: This day is spent high in the mountains of the world. Rock climbing goats and mountain lions are among the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads up Sutton Bank for a lambing with a view. However, there's no time to admire the surroundings because a lamb is stuck and it is too late for a C-section. Julian meets a pug with an unusual name and an unusual problem.

programme.title: Episode 10

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter treats a ewe that is struggling to give birth to twin lambs, and also performs a complicated and risky surgery on a tawny owl to remove the bird's ruptured eyeball.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: At Jackie Barlow's farm, Mako the alpaca has a lump on his face that's the size of half a football! And Mako is louder than a football crowd, with Julian admitting he's one of his noisiest patients ever.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Skeldale Student vet Molly turns to the Yorkshire vet for help as she brings in her cat Marlo who appears to have been shot in the head. Julian has to perform emergency surgery. Farmer Chris Colbeck is worried about his sheepdog Floss, who was run over by a tractor on the farm. Can Peter fix her wounded leg so that Floss can get back to her flock?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A much-loved trekking lama, Gus, has an excruciatingly painful problem. An orphaned kitten could have life-changing injuries. Julian's beloved Jack Russell, Emmie, gets into a skirmish. To relocate a male deer, Peter must use a highly dangerous dart gun. Julian dashes to save a beautiful, badly injured cow. Steve Green is nearly 90 years old and together with wife Jean he're still farming.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton visits a local farm to de-horn some lively young bullocks. Back at the surgery he and Peter Wright try to save the life of a dog that has got a large bone wedged in its oesophagus.

programme.title: All Farmers Great and Small
programme.desc: Julian Norton visits the young people putting everything they have into their number-one passion - farming. The programme celebrates the hard work and dedication of four young farmers, as they make their mark on the Yorkshire countryside.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian heads to the Taylors' farm where there's a double sheep emergency - a new mum and an expectant mum have both prolapsed. Peter meets Katie Perry - a superstar of a collie who requires emergency surgery.

programme.title: Jungle Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in some of the jungles of the world. Chimpanzees, orangutans and elephants feature.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian's patients include a horse with infected hooves, while Peter Wright is worried about a pedigree cat that is in labour and also has to deal with an angry monitor lizard. The two vets find time to attend the Great Yorkshire Show.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian and Peter have to cope with two night-time emergency call outs. New vet Esme performs her first emergency caesarean and a pack of bloodhound pups cause mayhem in the surgery.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Elderly Timmy, a Collie cross, is discovered in a house with a huge painful tumour on his face, but inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to give up on him. Inspector Helen Smith meets Archie, a stroppy Shih-Tzu that has become so matted, he can barely see or hear. Inspector Simon Evans pays a visit to two French Bulldog puppies, Yoda and Mogwai, that were found in Pontypool Park in Wales.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Greyhound Alinta needs to turn her life around after a hard start as a racing dog; Louise and her son Jack need a playful soul to fill their lives with joy. Will Bear, the cattle cross, be the one?

programme.title: More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off round the planet getting face to face with zoo babies, great and small. Tiny hippos in the hippo pond, rhino calf romping around, and a roller coaster ride with a pair of baby marmosets.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: When footage of a dog being beaten by his owner comes to the attention of the RSPCA, inspector Mel Fisher is straight on the case. It doesn't take long for her to rescue the young German Shepherd and bring the owner to justice. In Sunderland, inspector Jaqui Miller has her hands full when three generations of dogs are signed over by their struggling owner, and help has arrived just in time.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, farmer Richard Todd brings one of his much-loved semi-feral moggies into the practice. But 'Pretty Tom' isn't living up to his name. Peter believes the lump on Tom's face could be a life threatening tumour. To be safe, the mass must be removed urgently but Peter knows it will be extremely difficult surgery. Against all odds can Peter, with the help of Vet Helen, save Pretty Tom?

programme.desc: Julian races to help a pony with a large gash on her neck and Peter battles to save a sheep. A greedy cat has a stick stuck in his mouth and Julian faces a massive, messy job - pregnancy testing over 50 cows.

programme.desc: Teresa tiene que realizar unas prendas para un desfile. Además, Plácido participará en un torneo de tenis de mesa.

programme.title: Llegó el gusanitito
programme.desc: El bebé de Gaby ya está por nacer, y todos se preparan para recibirlo. Mientras tanto, Plácido y Adolfo hacen todo lo posible para llegar a tiempo y conocer al nuevo inquilino.

programme.title: El bebé de Rosegaby
programme.desc: Plácido ya está en su casa, pero todas las noches sueña con que su jefe regresa por él. Además, la familia piensa que el gusanitito está poseído porque se oyen ruidos extraños cada vez que él los visita.

programme.title: O se callan o se largan
programme.desc: Leopoldito llora demasiado y los vecinos se quejan del ruido exigiendo que los corran del edificio. Además, Gaby padece depresión posparto y rechaza a su propio bebé, por lo que su familia trata de ayudarla.

programme.title: No marches con la marcha
programme.desc: Plácido se reencuentra con un excompañero en Acapulco y decide aparentar que es millonario. Además, después de una marcha, Adolfo decide rebelarse contra La nena, pero su rebelión termina mal.

programme.title: En el mar la vida es más sabrosa
programme.desc: Martina encuentra trabajo y se siente más independiente. Además, La Nena y Adolfo tratan de convencer a Licha para irse de vacaciones a Acapulco y así deshacerse de ella, pero alguien más termina de viaje.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Carlos consigue trabajo como "wedding planner" en Acapulco, pero sus bodas no resultan ser como promete. Mientras tanto, Tere apuesta con una vecina que Gaby puede aprender a tejer.

programme.title: Reloj no manches las horas
programme.desc: El jefe de Plácido le pide cuidar su preciado y antiguo reloj, pero él lo pierde en la playa. Victoria pasa por cambios extraños en su cuerpo y nadie quiere explicarle qué le sucede.

programme.title: No te vaigas subcomandanta, no te vaigas
programme.desc: Plácido y Carlos son solicitados para animar una fiesta, pero los invitados son un público difícil. Nena se pone celosa debido a una visita inesperada.

programme.title: Se atormenta una vecina
programme.desc: Carlos presiente que se acerca un huracán en Acapulco, pero nadie le cree. Además, el administrador ha puesto una nueva regla después de cachar a Gaby y a Plutarco despidiéndose.

programme.title: Qué pedí yo
programme.desc: Martina tiene una clienta muy molesta que exige su dinero, pero, para su sorpresa, es amiga de Gaby y Plutarco. Mientras tanto, la Nena tiene una llamada importante y la familia piensa que engañará a Adolfo.

programme.title: Socio repartidor distinguido
programme.desc: Justito quiere pasar el examen de niños genio, pero cuidar a su hermanito podría arruinarlo. Además, Plácido está decidido a regresar a México, pero una tarea en Acapulco lo hará dudar de su decisión.

programme.title: Una nana explotada
programme.desc: Un descuido provoca que la cocina explote, por lo que deberán conseguir dinero para arreglarla. Mientras tanto, Plácido está desesperado por ver a su familia, así que idea un plan para volver.

programme.title: Departamento madre
programme.desc: El departamento de abajo queda en renta nuevamente y la familia López buscará una forma de rentarlo. Mientras tanto, hay una oportunidad en el colegio de genios, por lo que Justito podría dejar a sus papás.

programme.title: Fue en un cabaret donde me encontré chafeando

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks.

programme.title: Lord of Illusions
programme.desc: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps
programme.desc: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
programme.desc: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf.

programme.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
programme.desc: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself.

programme.title: Bitch Slap
programme.desc: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change.

programme.title: All Roads Lead to Rome
programme.desc: An uptight woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) reconnects with an old flame (Raoul Bova) after her rebellious daughter (Rosie Day) and the man's mother (Claudia Cardinale) run away together.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: From Prada to Nada
programme.desc: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Cruel Intentions
programme.desc: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
programme.desc: In the mid-21st century, an epidemic of organ failures leads to the rise of GeneCo., a company providing transplants at a great price. Those who miss their payments become targets of GeneCo. Mercenaries, who repossess the organs. In a world of drug addiction and legalized murder, a sheltered youth seeks a cure for her rare disease as well as information about her family's mysterious history. Her questions are answered at "The Genetic Opera."

programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's long-standing marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book.

programme.title: Laggies
programme.desc: When 28-year-old Megan attends her 10-year high-school reunion, she realizes that very little in her life has changed. An unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend sparks panic in Megan, causing her to wander off into the night. She meets 16-year-old Annika and proceeds to get drunk. Deciding she needs a break from her unfulfilling life, she tells her boyfriend she's going to a seminar but hangs with Annika.

programme.title: The Disaster Artist
programme.desc: The incredible true story of aspiring filmmaker and Hollywood outsider Tommy Wiseau as he and his best friend defiantly pursue their dreams and embark on the hilarious odyssey of making the now-infamous, cult classic "The Room."

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: Coming Soon
programme.desc: Privileged teenage friends Jenny (Gaby Hoffmann), Nell (Tricia Vessey) and Stream (Bonnie Root) spend their senior year on a quest to rid Stream of her virginity. However, Stream wants more than just her first sexual experience. She wants to have an orgasm -- but achieving this proves problematic, as the boys she meets are hardly sensitive enough to provide her the release she seeks. When it becomes clear that Nell and Jenny have never experienced an orgasm either, all three set out to get one.

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Unintended Consequences
programme.desc: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother?s honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

programme.title: Played in My Face
programme.desc: Tonya's life is almost picture perfect, and a wedding on the horizon to the man of her dreams, Victor. One night she receives an anonymous email exposing Victor at a hotel on the same night he claimed to be away on business. Her quiet suspicion spirals into obsession as she discovers that Victor's betrayal runs deeper than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter's life grows more personal and more urgent.

programme.title: Somebody's Got to Die
programme.desc: After leading a life of contract killing, Jake makes a promise to his fiancé, Nicole, to go on the straight and narrow. He finds solace in running a bar with his brother Kelvin. When his former Kingpin Marcel offers him a way out, he is forced to confront shadows of his past, and overcome one of the biggest jobs of his criminal career.

programme.title: Deceptive Touch
programme.desc: Cam believes she's finally found The One in her charismatic boyfriend Ant. Everything seems perfect until a shocking discovery about Ant's past threatens to unravel their idyllic life. As Cam digs for answers, passion turns into paranoia, and a twisted game of lies and manipulation threatens to destroy everything she thought she knew.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Love and Coffee
programme.desc: The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.

programme.title: Da Neighborhood Dopemane
programme.desc: Struggling with his finances working as a mechanic, CrimMane chooses the dope track as his side hustle, until a client offers him a dangerous proposition.

programme.title: Don't Shoot
programme.desc: After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

programme.title: Her Best Revenge
programme.desc: After a tragic death, five fraternity brothers reunite at a vacation home, while the shadow of a death from their past lingers over them. A mysterious figure begins to send them threatening messages. Their secrets and loyalties are put to the test and they must uncover the truth about what happened that night five years ago.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends - DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine - are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: Her Last Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Athena Hart thought she had seen every kind of broken soul, until Lucas Morningstar walked into her office. What begins as therapy quickly twists into a deadly game of obsession and revenge. With her marriage crumbling, her assistant missing, and her reputation on the line, Athena must confront the terrifying truth.q

programme.title: Kill em with a Smile
programme.desc: Happily married Jessica has accepted that she is going to die from a terminal illness, and isn't afraid of death. Her real fear however, is her husband Reginald falling back in love with his ex Rebecca, and stealing the life she built.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: Bee Hive
programme.desc: Three women face financial woes and look to dealing for local drug lord Zeus. Jealousy, intimidation, and greed set in, when Zeus sees that they are selling and pushing faster than he ever could and suspects they are cutting in on him.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: Battered Emotions
programme.desc: Rasheada has accepted that her battle with breast cancer is inevitable but her spiritual fight is still as strong as ever. She continues her upbeat facade for friends and family, but is unsure how long it will be until she can no longer compete with her emotional life's journey. Her sister, Tara, and her best friend, Bunny, struggle with their own issues of inner demons and domestic violence, while trying to support Rasheada through her battle.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she's always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she's truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: A Love Letter to the Beatles
programme.desc: This joyous, fan-funded documentary celebrates The Beatles' enduring legacy through the eyes of their global fanbase. Eight years in the making, it traces their journey from The Quarrymen to global icons, exploring how their music transcends generations and borders, uniting fans and offering profound meaning.

programme.title: A Deadly Friend
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. When her single father Drew starts seeing the school principal, Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, pulling the veil on Magic's sinister nature.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: The Kitty Hallow Killer
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in Houston killing pedophiles and rapists. When Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband, Mason, could be The Kitty Hallow Killer.
